records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Overview**
The
**Plant Manager**
is a strategic leader entrusted with overseeing all operational activities at our Sauget, IL facility (Greater St. Louis area). Reporting to the business unit President, the Plant Manager will play a critical role in driving safety, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, continuous improvement, and frontline obsession. You will also provide exceptional leadership and professional development to the Operations team. The successful candidate will have strong people leadership skills, the ability to easily communicate strategy and direction to all levels of the organization, a demonstrated track record of operational success, and working knowledge of Lean principles. They will constantly strive to exceed customer expectations through excellent customer service levels and customer-first customization.
 
 
Established in 1959 and headquartered in Sauget, IL, Universal Air Filter (UAF) is part of Filtration Group LLC, the world’s leading filtration company. UAF designs and manufactures custom air filters used to protect commercial equipment and electronics enclosures. With exceptional design and application knowledge and understanding of thermal management in complex equipment and cabinets, UAF is a valuable partner for global OEMs serving all types of electronics and industrial machinery end markets. Engineering design support and quick-turn, custom prototypes are provided to engineer prospects and customers operating under ambitious product development cycles. UAF filters are engineered to address the challenges of thermal management, dust contamination, airflow control, fire safety, EMI shielding, and size limitations in crowded electronic enclosures.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
Reporting to the business unit President, the Plant Manager will play a critical role in driving safety, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, continuous improvement, and frontline obsession. You will also provide exceptional leadership and professional development to the Operations team. The successful candidate will have strong people leadership skills, the ability to easily communicate strategy and direction to all levels of the organization, a demonstrated track record of operational success, and working knowledge of Lean principles. They will constantly strive to exceed customer expectations through excellent customer service levels and customer-first customization.
 
 
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s of Science in Engineering or similar. Concentration in Mechanical, Civil, Systems, or Chemical Engineering strongly preferred.
* MBA/advanced degree a plus
* 10+ years of Operations experience in a manufacturing environment
* 5+ years of experience leading operations and/or supply chain teams, preferably in a batch or custom products environment
* Hands-on experience in implementing and driving sustainable performance
* Pay Salaried ($120,000)
* Additional Comments:
* The essential functions have been provided as example of the type of work performed by employees assigned to this job classification. The company reserves the right to modify the work assignments and/or to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions. The job description is not intended to be an inclusive list of duties and responsibilities. It is intended to describe the general nature of the position.
* Filtration Group now part of Parker Hannifin is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Parker is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job related reasons regardless of race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law. However, U.S. Citizenship, Permanent Residency or other appropriate status is required for certain positions, in accord with U.S. import & export regulations.

(“Minority / Female / Disability / Veteran / VEVRAA Federal Contractor”)
 
 

* If you would like more information about Equal Employment Opportunity as an applicant under the law, please go to Employees & Job Applicants | U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission

records.title: Plant Manager - Recycling
records.description:
**it’s what’s inside that counts**
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
There’s more to CMC than our products and the buildings, structures, and roads they go into. At CMC, it’s the people inside our recycling centers, fabrication plants, manufacturing facilities, steel mills and offices that make us who we are as a company. Our success comes from finding, retaining, and supporting the highest quality talent by offering:
 
 

* Day 1 Benefits Coverage with low cost Medical, Vision, Dental
* Day 1 Paid-time Off and Vacation
* 4.5% Company Match 401(k) plan
* $500 Annual Company-paid Lifestyle Benefit
* Competitive Compensation and Bonuses
* Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Training and Advancement Opportunities

**Why This Job**
CMC provides an excellent opportunity to learn the steel, construction reinforcement and ground stabilization industries and to grow in your career. Whether you will spend your day brainstorming in an office cubicle, operating a crane, running manufacturing equipment or troubleshooting technical obstacles, at CMC, you’ll get the training and support from your team that you need to excel in your role and reach your full potential.
 
 
**What You'll Do**

* Lead in a professional manner toward achieving company performance goals with emphasis on safety, quality and all company standards
* Direct all activities of the Area including accounting, shipping, receiving, operations, safety and environmental
* Champion and ensure adherence to CMC’s Guiding Principles, Code of Conduct, Culture, and policies and procedures
* Must be able to establish operational goals, both financial and non-financial, with clear work plans, and hold management staff accountable
* Responsible for the planning of budgets, company assets, labor forecasts and capital expenditures for short-term and long-range production
* Collaborate with different departments to ensure successful accomplishments of company goals
* Develop and lead a Safety Culture that is consistent with CMC standards
* Control inventory dollars and tons by meeting inventory turn standards set forth by the company
* Provides guidance and direction to staff including hiring, disciplinary action, staff development, goal formulation and performance review
* Ensures compliance with employment laws and regulations, minimizing the company's exposure to adverse outcomes of complaints, litigation, audits and inspections

**What You'll Need**

* Must be able to maintain and be familiar with safety and environmental concerns
* Past successful experience in operations, marketing, sales in a metal recycling facility or other related industry a strong plus
* Must be able to control budgeted labor and overtime costs; as well as, maintain fiscal responsibility for all departments' budgets
* Understands and executes CMC accounting policies, RONA, Working Capital, Operating Profit, and Business strategies.
* Extensive knowledge of all areas of operations
* Preferred familiarity with material handling equipment and how to properly maintain (maintenance programs) and repair equipment
* Must collaborate and develop strong relationships with people to ensure successful accomplishments of plant and regional goals
* Ability to make sure all employees are trained and well prepared to carry out their daily tasks to ensure everyone's safety
* Able to clearly communicate expectations, issues and feedback
* Must be able to problem solve in all areas of plant
* Proficiency with computer operating systems, to include Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) required
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate up, down, and across the business

**Your Education**

* High School Diploma or GED required
* Bachelor's Degree strongly preferred

We are CMC, a Fortune 500® company at the leading edge of our industry. Our construction reinforcement and steel products have supported construction projects and structures around the world. The secret to our success? We’ve built our legacy by assembling a team of innovators and doers to tackle some of the most challenging construction reinforcement problems facing our world for more than 100 years — and we’re just getting started.
 
 
If you’re ready to join a team working to make our industry more sustainable, support the bridges, roadways, buildings and infrastructure that connects our communities, and do meaningful work, you’re ready to join CMC. Apply today and start moving your career — and our world — forward. Let's build a better world!
 
 
*CMC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, physical or mental disability, national origin, citizenship, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, or other status protected by federal, state or local law.*
*From Fortune Magazine. © 2025 Fortune Media IP Limited. All rights reserved. Used under license.*

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Job Description**
**Summary:**
The Plant Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the entire manufacturing facility including safety, quality, efficiencies and meeting customer expectations. This includes driving strategic plans that ensure that production goals are met in the most cost-effective manner delivering expected financial results.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Ensures that the facility provides the highest quality products produced in the most efficient manner within budgeted costs. Implements systems to effectively manage production schedules properly supporting the business.
* Leads the effort and drives Lean Manufacturing tools and techniques fostering continuous improvement within the facility.
* Acts in a proactive fashion regarding problem resolution.
* Manages profit and loss for the facility and drives Plant performance and reviews KPIs regularly (Daily, weekly and monthly).
* Leads the overall strategic planning efforts for the location which include cost reduction initiatives, capital planning and resources as well as in other areas.
* Manages the overall safety, quality, scheduling, production, shipping, maintenance and other administrative functions for the facility.
* Leads the effort in maintaining a safe, clean and efficient operation working within all company guidelines and local/state/federal regulations.
* Strives to improve the plant’s safety accident record year over year in creating a positive safety culture for all employees. Conducts safety walks of the facility on a weekly basis.
* Conducts talent reviews. Trains, develops and motivates staff in an effort to optimize the workforce. Delivers performance reviews and any feedback to the team as needed.
* Conducts weekly staff meetings which focus on key operative measurements.
* Schedules and conducts plant communication meetings for all employees.
* Interfaces with customers and suppliers. Visits both as necessary.
* Works as necessary to establish positive community relationships.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Minimum of a high school diploma. Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Operations or Business Management preferred
* Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in operations, maintenance, engineering and/or process Improvement roles including managing teams of people
* Previous experience working in a Lean environment.
* Six Sigma Green or Black Belt Certification a plus
* Proven experience and record of successes in a high-speed manufacturing environment. Experience with plastic injection molding environment, and metal processing/metal forming strong preferred
* Experience in a commercial role with direct customer contact
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with process development and business process design.
* Experience managing to the ISO or equivalent quality standards
* Experience implementing and/or managing to an Operating System (example: the Toyota Production Systems)
* Bilingual English/Spanish a plus, but not required

**About Us**
Do you want to work with people who are dedicated to innovation and making the world a better place? Do you want to build a career with a company that provides opportunities for growth and development?
 
 
Mauser Packaging Solutions is that company.
 
 
Our mission is to help our customers achieve better sustainability with their packaging. And we do that by giving our people the opportunity to do important work, solve interesting problems and be part of a diverse, forward-looking team.
 
 
At Mauser Packaging Solutions, you can be proud to work for a company that’s always striving to innovate and serve customers better—and help them be better stewards of the environment.
 
 
Whether you’re a seasoned professional—or just beginning your career—there’s a place where you can help make a difference at Mauser Packaging Solutions. Join us!
 
 
Mauser Packaging Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Job ID: 530934
 
 
Ash Grove is a CRH company with a legacy dating back to 1882. We combine technical expertise, safety and customer-focused solutions to deliver reliable performance for our customers. We manufacture and supply high-performance, advanced cementitious materials for the most demanding construction and infrastructure needs. With more than 2,000 people across 60 locations in the United States and Canada, we support a wide range of applications, from major infrastructure projects to the development and refurbishment of residential and non-residential buildings that support everyday life, from highways and bridges to schools and commercial buildings.
 
 
To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com
 
 
\*\*Job Summary\*\*
 
 
The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.
 
 
\*\*Job Location\*\*
 
 

* This role will work out of our plant in Midlothian, TX.

\*\*Job Responsibilities\*\*
 
 

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines.
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.

\*\*Job Requirements\*\*
 
 

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year - Bachelors Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy

\*\*What CRH Offers You\*\*
 
 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

\*\*About CRH\*\*
 
 
CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.
 
 
If you're up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!
 
 
Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
 
EOE/Vet/Disability
 
 
CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.

records.description:
**Job Description**
The Plant Manager will oversee operations which include environmental, health & safety, quality, production, maintenance, capital planning and execution in a cost-effective manner while meeting all customer requirements.
 
 
**Essential Duties/Responsibilities**
Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.
 
 

* Support, mentor and develop plant management and supervisory personnel through regular coaching and formal development tools.
* Lead all safety improvement initiatives and create a safety-based culture.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory agencies including, OSHA, EPA, HACCP and other local and regional agencies.
* Prepare monthly reports, analyze financial budgets and take corrective measures as needed.
* Maintain efficient and timely flow of all raw materials received and ingredients shipped.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts in all areas of responsibility.
* Review and lead local Capital Projects, planning process to ensure compliance and development of assets for ongoing success and improvement.
* Ensure all personnel properly trained and equipment is in good working order to meet ongoing and future business needs.
* Assure all finish product shipped is in accordance with all quality standards and specifications.
* Effectively manage and reduce energy use at facility.
* Manage local purchasing activities.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High School diploma or GED equivalent.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in a supervisory/ management position in an industrial or plant setting.
* Rendering industry experience is a definite plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred; Engineering degree is an asset.
* Labor relations background and leadership preferred.
* Detail oriented; highly organized.
* Ability to work well with internal staff.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
* Self-starter; self-motivated.
* Good math and computer skills.

**Working Environment**
Occasionally = up to 20% Frequently = up to 21% to 50% Constantly - at least 51%
 
 

* Exposed to unpleasant or disagreeable physical environments such as high noise level, strong odors, and/or exposure to heat and cold: Constantly
* Exposed to bio hazardous conditions: Constantly
* Exposed to toxic or caustic chemicals which mandate attention to safety considerations: Constantly
* Exposed to Electrical hazards; risk of electrical shock: Frequently
* Handles or works with potentially dangerous equipment: Constantly

**Physical Demands**
Occasionally = up to 20% Frequently = up to 21% to 50% Constantly - at least 51%
 
 

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position: Frequently
* Must be able to move about inside/outside office or work location: Frequently
* Operates a computer and other office machinery: Frequently
* Must be able to position oneself to maintain computers in the lab, including under desks and in the server closet: Frequently
* Must be able to ascend/descend on a ladder: Frequently
* Must be able to use senses to; effectively communicate with co-workers and clients and detect hazardous conditions: Frequently
* Must be able to occasionally lift up to 50lbs

records.title: Manufacturing Ops Mgr / Plant Manager
records.description:
**What You Will Get**

* Competitive hourly pay
* Paid weekly
* Opportunity for annual performance increase
* 401K program with employer matching
* Room for growth and career advancement
* Health insurance
* Dental & vision Insurance
* Paid life Insurance
* Paid short term disability
* Paid vacation and sick time
* 11 paid holidays
* Health & Wellness Programs
* Employee Discount Programs

**What You'll Do**

* Own overall plant operations (production, material handling, inventory, and logistics) to meet throughput, quality, and profitability targets.
* Lead safety culture: conduct/oversee daily safety meetings, enforce ARC 100 and company safety programs, investigate incidents, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal requirements, including environmental and labor regulations.
* Plan and direct daily operations; monitor workflow and KPIs; identify and implement operational improvements and cost savings.
* Oversee maintenance and reliability: ensure preventive maintenance programs are followed, coordinate repairs and downtime planning, and verify maintenance documentation.
* Supervise, coach, and develop plant personnel; manage scheduling, timekeeping, attendance, performance feedback, and disciplinary actions as needed.
* Communicate routinely with Area Manager, Sales, and Dispatch regarding inbound/outbound materials, quantities, trucking needs, and upcoming work.
* Support customer and vendor relationships; ensure product availability and service meet expectations.
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation; stay current through training and industry best practices.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**

* Experience: 3+ years in aggregate recycling operations or other process/production environment (5+ years and crushing plant equipment experience preferred)
* Ability to work in all weather conditions.
* Ability to stand for extended periods of time at conveyor belt operation.
* Ability to climb heights of 20 feet on a regular basis.
* Ability to lift, carry, and/or pull 50 pounds on a regular basis.
* Ability to work in dusty, wet, and loud environment.
* Required to wear safety equipment including hard hat, safety glasses, goggles, steel toed boots, ear plugs, gloves and various other similar items as required or needed.

*The statements above describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as requested by management. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and may be modified to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.*

Want to learn more about this role and Jobot? Click our Jobot logo and follow
 
our LinkedIn page!
 
 
 
Job details:
 
**Plant Manager - St. Louis, MO**
This Jobot Job is hosted by: Madison Fincher
 
Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button
 
and sending us your resume.
 
Salary: $120,000 - $150,000 per year
 
 
 
**A bit about us:**
Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri with more than 1,200 employees and nearing $2B in revenue. A diversified construction company that partners with leading organizations throughout North America to build their most challenging and important projects.
 
 
Provides construction solutions to the automotive, commercial, civil, energy, food & beverage, healthcare, heavy industrial, industrial process, and water industries.
 
 
Our Values:
 
 
Working Safely
 
Valuing Diversity
 
Serving Humbly
 
Executing with Integrity
 
Solving Creatively
 
Engaging Fully
 
 
 
**Why join us?**
Profit-sharing plan, cash bonus programs and annual cost-of-living adjustments
 
Generous salary increases and per diems for qualified out-of-town assignments
 
Health, dental and vision insurance eligibility on day one
 
Paid parental leave
 
Continuing education reimbursement
 
Personalized career development and training programs
 
Minimum of 29 days of PTO (including holidays) for entry-level roles
 
Fitness center for St. Louis office-based team members
 
Gym membership reimbursement for project-based team members
 
Corporate office cafeteria access
 
Employee Resource Group (ERG) opportunities
 
Philanthropy opportunities
 
 
 
**Job Details**
The Plant Manager directs and manages all plant operations with overall responsibilities for production, maintenance, quality and other production-related activities as a part of a premier structural steel fabricator and erector.
 
 
Essential Responsibilities & Duties include the following; however, other duties may be assigned. The Company provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with a disability, unless doing so poses an undue hardship on the Company. To be a qualified individual, an employee must be able to perform each of the essential functions of his or her job with or without a reasonable accommodation.
 
 
Directs and manages Responsible for labor relations and managing union issues associated with craft labor.
 
Manages capital asset maintenance.
 
Establishes and monitors overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
 
Controls and minimizes repair expenses.
 
Maintains existing plant facilities and equipment; replaces or makes adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary.
 
Provides leadership and training to accomplish Company goals and objectives.
 
Implements and maintains preventative maintenance programs.
 
Incorporates shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
 
Manages and directs non-supervisory administrative or union employees and is responsible for the overall direction and management of these employees.
 
Travels to Company and subsidiary offices; offsite client, subcontractor, and supplier meetings; and other locations across North America to fulfill the essential duties of the role as required.
 
Exhibits regular and reliable attendance in person as required by the Supervisor, Company guidelines, and/or project and office obligations.
 
Education and Experience
 
 
Bachelor's degree and 5 years’ plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
 
 
Experience managing in a union environment required.
 
Working knowledge of budgets and financials statements required.
 
Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.
 
 
Interested in hearing more? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button.
 
 
Jobot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide an inclusive work environment that celebrates diversity and all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, military status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Jobot also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is Jobot’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.
 
 
Sometimes Jobot is required to perform background checks with your authorization. Jobot will consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in a manner consistent with any applicable federal, state, or local law regarding criminal backgrounds, including but not limited to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
 
 
Information collected and processed as part of your Jobot candidate profile, and any job applications, resumes, or other information you choose to submit is subject to Jobot's Privacy Policy, as well as the Jobot California Worker Privacy Notice and Jobot Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tools which are available at jobot.com/legal.
 
 
By applying for this job, you agree to receive calls, AI-generated calls, text messages, or emails from Jobot, and/or its agents and contracted partners. Frequency varies for text messages. records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
ResourceTek is the Human Capital division of Barge Design Solutions, a multi-discipline Engineering and Architecture firm. We specialize in providing technical recruitment and staffing services to industry and government in all areas of Engineering, Information Technology, and a broad range of other technical disciplines.

In partnership with our client, a leading U.S. manufacturer of copper and aluminum building wire and cable, ResourceTek is seeking an experienced, solutions-driven
**Plant Manager**
to join the team at their facility located near
**Jackson, MS**
.

The right candidate will be responsible and accountable for making decisions that affect employee health & safety, employee relations, employee growth & development, facility profitability, quality of products, customer satisfaction, and local/regional community relationships. Develops manufacturing budgets and plans to meet production goals within budget.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Lead all aspects of the manufacturing operations and development activities of the plant to achieve short and long-term goals to meet customer and company expectations.

· Drive world-class processes in the areas of EH&S, developing a solid safety culture within the plant in order to achieve an accident-free work environment, providing prompt and effective action to eliminate unsafe acts or conditions as they become apparent.

· Propose and execute plant operational budgets, capital budgets, sales forecasts and resource requirements.

· Lead the manufacturing functions in the plant on all shifts to ensure on-time production and shipment of conforming products and materials. Including: planning the production flow, troubleshooting manufacturing issues, handling staffing issues, and monitoring production orders and schedules.

· Develop and implement sustainable manufacturing processes needed to manufacture high-quality products on time.

· Identify opportunities for improvement across the plant in relation to process, equipment, facilities and staffing and drive implementation in a spirit of continuous improvement.

· Maintain and control plant inventories to inventory plan to meet anticipated customer demands without excess investment.

· Responsible for the integrity of all the plant-related data and information.

· Continually monitor results achieved in relation to planned goals and undertake necessary corrective action to achieve the desired results.

· Drive the implementation and execution of robust quality systems to ensure product quality meets and exceeds customer expectations.

· Manage plant project list to set priorities and ensure they are completed in a timely manner.

· Develop and engage with all employees in order to develop a favorable employee relations environment and work with staff members on their personal growth and development goals to ensure employees feel encouraged and motivated to contribute at their full potential.

· Provide leadership for problem resolution to facilitate faster improvements and improved working relations.

**REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS**

· Bachelor’s degree in business or engineering preferred

· 10+ years’ experience in manufacturing, including experience in a supervisory or managerial capacity, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

· 5+ years’ manufacturing experience in a process-based environment; wire and cable experience preferred.

· 5+ years manufacturing plant/general management experience

· Extensive and proven experience in Lean Manufacturing, strong track record of leading in a continuous improvement environment.

· Six Sigma / Lean Manufacturing Experience / Training

SKILLS & ABILITIES

· Strong leadership skills and presence

· Demonstrated history of hiring, retaining, and promoting team members

· Ability to build a safety-focused culture that is a great place to work

· Understand the financials of the plant and drive the necessary improvements to achieve and exceed financial and production targets

· Action and solution-oriented leader with strong sense of urgency

· Strong focus on understanding and meeting Customer needs

· Ability to manage multiple priorities

· Ability to build people’s capabilities – Coach and develop teams

· Results oriented with excellent organizational, problem solving, and interpersonal skills

· Seeks out information to understand root causes and drive effective decision-making

· Proven knowledge in budgeting, expense management, and capital equipment analysis

· Knowledge of plant manufacturing systems

· Demonstrated ability to lead people and get results through others

· Clear understanding of effective manufacturing practices in the areas of safety, quality, cost, productivity, and delivery

· Ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing with customers and employees at all levels

· Computer proficiency (especially MS Office: Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

If you're looking for a stable career with an established manufacturer that values safety, teamwork, and continuous improvement, we encourage you to apply today!

Company offers a competitive salary with
**25% annual bonus**
and a comprehensive benefits package that includes tuition reimbursement, 401k/Roth with company match, and more. Equal Opportunity Employer.

records.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the development and execution of the Electrical Infrastructure division's manufacturing technology strategy to support growth, operational excellence, and financial performance. This role drives the identification, industrialization, and deployment of advanced manufacturing technologies, including automation, robotics, machine vision, controls, and digital manufacturing systems. Responsibilities include developing multi-year manufacturing roadmaps, leading capital investment planning, establishing engineering and equipment standards, and overseeing high-impact manufacturing initiatives. The Director partners with Operations, Finance, and business leaders to improve safety, quality, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

Legrand is the global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures. Its comprehensive offering of solutions for residential, commercial, and datacenter markets makes it a benchmark for customers worldwide.

Bridging power from sources to pathways to touchpoints, Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division combines innovation and quality to provide leading solutions for an evolving energy landscape. Our expertly designed products enable customers to confidently address the complex needs and challenges of electrification, while enhancing everyday experiences like plugging in, switching on, and staying connected. Committed to best-in-class service at every stage, we act as a trusted partner for our customers to ensure each project's success and their continued satisfaction. Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division includes the following brands and product lines: Girtz, Avtron, Power Bus Way, Cablofil, Connectrac, Wiremold and Pass & Seymour.

Legrand, North & Central America offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as distinctive benefits like a high employer 401K match, paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay, short-term and long-term disability benefit plans, above-benchmark paid maternity and parental leave, bonus opportunities in accordance with the Company's incentive plans, paid time off to volunteer, and an active/growing Employee Resource Group network. For more information, visit legrand.us.

**At a Glance**

**Legrand**
has an exciting opportunity for a
**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to join the
**Electrical Infrastructure division.**
This leader identifies, develops, industrializes, and scales manufacturing processes, automation, autonomation, equipment, and digital capabilities that improve safety, quality, service, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering advises, develops, and executes operational business strategies with the VP of Operations and EI division Leadership Team in support of EI growth and financial goals. Those strategies include footprint and capacity expansion, factory roles, insourcing/outsourcing, operating constraints, and growth enablement into a multiyear manufacturing technology roadmap. The role provides technical leadership for significant manufacturing investments, establishes common engineering and equipment standards, and ensures solutions are economically justified, successfully industrialized, and deliver sustained operating and financial results.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering is expected to determine when advanced technology creates differentiated value and when a simpler process, equipment, maintenance, sourcing, or product solution is more appropriate.

This position leads a focused technical organization that works through plant resources, internal partners, equipment suppliers, and qualified integrators.

**What Will You Do?**

**Manufacturing Technology Strategy**

* Develop and maintain a multiyear advanced manufacturing roadmap aligned with business strategy, factory roles, product requirements, capacity needs, and footprint plans.
* Evaluate and deploy appropriate manufacturing technologies, including automation, autonomation, robotics, machine vision, controls, advanced tooling, and digital manufacturing systems.
* Identify manufacturing capabilities the division should protect, build, standardize, modernize, source externally, or retire.
* Adapt technology strategies to differences in product complexity, volume, mix, demand stability, and operating model.

**Opportunity Portfolio and Investment Leadership**

* Build and prioritize a network-wide portfolio of advanced manufacturing, automation, and equipment-modernization opportunities.
* Define the operating loss or constraint being addressed, credible alternatives, expected business impact, investment requirement, lifecycle cost, risk, payback, and sustainment requirements.
* Determine when technology creates differentiated value and when process redesign, tooling, equipment refurbishment, maintenance improvement, outsourcing, product redesign, or another solution is more appropriate.
* Serve as the division's technical authority for significant manufacturing technology and equipment investments.
* Support footprint, make-versus-buy, capacity, and capital-allocation decisions with clear technical facts and alternatives.
* Lead the division governance process for manufacturing capital planning and deployment, providing consolidated visibility to investment requirements, approvals, timing, expenditure, implementation risk, and expected benefits.
* Partner with Operations, business General Managers, and Finance to develop and maintain a prioritized multi-year manufacturing plan.
* Monitor the deployment of approved manufacturing investments and escalate material risks involving scope, cost, schedule, technical performance, plant readiness, or benefit realization.

**Technical Industrialization and Standards**

* Establish standards for manufacturing equipment, automation, controls, tooling, data connectivity, safety, maintainability, and industrialization.
* Lead technical reviews of equipment specifications, process concepts, integrator selection, designs, risk assessments, acceptance testing, process capability, documentation, training, and critical spares.
* Ensure new processes incorporate quality at source, error-proofing, equipment reliability, operator safety, cybersecurity, and appropriate performance visibility.
* Establish preferred technology platforms, reusable equipment concepts, and qualified supplier and integrator networks where standardization creates value.

**Deployment and Sustainable Results**

* Lead the technical delivery of selected high-value, high-risk, or highly replicable manufacturing initiatives.
* Define when central AME involvement is required and when plant teams can execute within established standards.
* Establish clear ownership for technical development, plant readiness, commissioning, production ramp, and ongoing sustainment.
* Transfer solutions to plant ownership after safety, capability, reliability, training, documentation, maintenance, and performance requirements have been met.
* Conduct post-implementation reviews to verify that operating and financial benefits are achieved and sustained.
* Capture lessons learned and creates replication methods for proven solutions.

**Organization and Capability Development**

* Build and develop a high-performance advanced manufacturing engineering team with the technical depth required to support the division's strategy.
* Define which capabilities should be retained internally and which should be accessed through plants, internal partners, equipment suppliers, engineering firms, or system integrators.
* Establish expectations for supplier and integrator performance, documentation, intellectual property, lifecycle support, and reuse of developed solutions.
* Develop plant technical capability to minimize long-term dependence on central resources or external partners.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Experience:**

* At least 10 years of progressive experience in advanced manufacturing engineering, automation, process engineering, or industrialization, including five years leading technical teams or multisite programs.
* Demonstrated experience in automation, robotics, autonomation, controls, machine vision, advanced tooling, or manufacturing data systems.
* Experience with equipment specifications, integrator management, design reviews, acceptance testing, commissioning, capability validation, and production handoff.
* Broad manufacturing-process knowledge and experience in both high-mix and higher-volume environments.
* Proven record of turning manufacturing technology investments into sustained operating and financial results.

**Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:**

* Strong understanding of capital economics, lifecycle cost, capacity analysis, labor impact, and benefit realization.
* Ability to translate operating losses and business requirements into prioritized technical opportunities.
* Ability to determine when advanced technology is appropriate and when a simpler operational solution will create greater value.
* Ability to translate technical complexity into clear business decisions and influence across a matrixed organization.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Finance, Product Engineering, Quality, EHS, HR, IT, Supply Chain, Lean, and PMO teams.
* Strong supplier, equipment manufacturer, and system-integrator management capabilities.
* Ability to balance enterprise standardization with legitimate differences across products, processes, plants, and operating models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical professionals, develop organizational capability, and operate effectively across multiple businesses and manufacturing locations.

records.title: Director of Engineering & Continuous Improvement
records.description:
**Position Summary**

The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.

The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.

The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.

***This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.***

***Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.***

**Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to**

Process & Technical Engineering

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* **10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams**
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree
 **Physical Requirements**

**Physical Requirements**

* Regularly required to use hands to feel, grab, or operate objects, tools, and controls while reaching with hands and arms
* Frequently required to stand, communicate, and listen
* Occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel or crouch
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Able to perform repetitive movements
* Able to work in variable temperatures (cold/hot)

records.title: Director, Manufacturing Excellence - Engineering
records.description:
**Title**
: Director, Manufacturing Excellence - Engineering

**Reports to:**
AVP, Manufacturing Excellence (ME) - Engineering - BKK Office

**Location**
: NYC Corporate office, TriBeCa

**Estimated Base Salary:**
$190,000 - $215,000 annually

**Compensation & Benefits**

Base pay is one component of Company’s total compensation package, which may also include the following for eligible employees: access to healthcare benefits, 401(k) plan, bonus, employee discounts, Summer Fridays (corporate roles), generous paid time off, sick time, and more.

**Overview**

The Director, Manufacturing Engineer, in conjunction with the AVP of ME, will assist the NY Design and PD teams in engineering new product. They will help troubleshoot engineering challenges from design inception, attend DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and CTM (Concept to Manufacturing) meetings, with the intention of starting as early as possible to foresee possible issues and bottle necks in production. Collaborate with the DY Shop to ensure final production methods are being considered when developing techniques and finishes for Design Approval. Oversee all ECN Projects from start to completion. Work closely with Manufacturing Partners, remotely and on-site, throughout the development process to ensure engineering standards are upheld. As a hands-on technical leader in New York, this Director role will also provide bench-level support for the Women’s Mainline project, work directly with vendors across the US and Europe, and mentor the junior Manufacturing Excellence team member in NY through coaching, teaching, and day-to-day technical guidance.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Work closely with NY based design leadership early in the development process to ensure engineering needs are met
* Serve as a hands-on bench partner on the Women’s Mainline project, validating construction, finishing, and manufacturing methods while supporting the NY design and product development teams.
* Work daily with BKK ME Team to promote inter-office cohesion
* Coordinate closely with the Bangkok Manufacturing Excellence team to align technical standards, share learnings, and support a consistent global manufacturing strategy.
* Work closely with Product Development Team to evaluate and determine best practices for producing Company Jewelry
* Provide direct technical coaching and mentoring to the junior Manufacturing Excellence team member in New York, including training in problem-solving, vendor communication, and engineering best practices.
* Interact closely with vendor base (with focus on domestic and Italian vendors) to guarantee understanding of first sample execution, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, ensure QC standards are met and communicate learnings to cross functional teams
* Expand direct technical support to vendors across the US and Europe, with a hands-on role in resolving sample issues, improving manufacturability, and closing the loop on critical engineering actions.
* Document best practices in a Manufacturing Excellence Manual with ongoing revisions and updates as needed
* Participant in the R&D, DFM & CTM Committees
* Partner with R&D team to vet manufacturing feasibility
* Partner with the DY Shop on creating prototypes and reference samples for design consideration and vendor reference during sampling phase
* Own ECN projects including vendor communication, inspecting models and assembly methods, coming up with solutions or alternatives to correct known issues, obtain final updated vendor samples that pass DY QC and communicate to repair team when solutions are implemented
* Keep up to date on new manufacturing techniques and technologies
* Domestic and international travel required

**Essential Qualifications**

* Education: Four-year BA or BS degree in Mechanical Engineering/Industrial Design
* Minimum 8+ years of practical Jewelry Manufacturing experience (including production manufacturing) OR equivalent tenured jewelry manufacturing experience
* Extensive hands-on model making and jewelry assembly experience in sterling silver, gold alloys, platinum, Titanium and Aluminum
* Extensive knowledge of Jewelry casting, including rubber mold and wax production
* Extensive knowledge of Stone Setting Techniques including Hand Pave, Pin Set, Bezel Setting, Prong Setting, baguette setting and invisible setting. Hands on experience preferred
* A thorough knowledge of Electro-plating with White and Black Rhodium including both pen plating and bath plating
* Experience with multiple finishing techniques such as Oxidation on Silver, Satin, Burnished and Mechanical Finishing
* A high level of understanding of RHINO 3D Version 8 and Rapid Prototyping
* A strong understanding of jewelry mechanisms such as clasps, hinges, and springs
* A keen understanding of Stamping and Machining techniques
* Ability to troubleshoot problems at every stage of the jewelry manufacturing process
* A good sense of Design
* Computer Skills: Familiarity with Rhino, Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and mechanical drawing software and /or Adobe Photo Client
* Demonstrated hands-on bench jewelry manufacturing experience with the ability to analyze complex product construction, manufacturing methods, and engineering challenges.
* Proven ability to mentor and develop engineering talent while providing technical leadership across cross-functional teams.

records.title: Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement
records.description:
The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.
 
 
The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.
 
 
The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.
 
 
**This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.**
**Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.**
**Benefits**
Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.
 
 
**Benefits Include**

* PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice
* 401(k) match
* Life insurance
* Short-term disability
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Maternity/paternity leave
* Health savings account (HSA)
* Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

**Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To**
Process & Technical Engineering
 
 

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
 
 

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering
 
 

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects
 
 

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership
 
 

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development
 
 

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree

**Physical Requirements**

* Regularly required to use hands to feel, grab, or operate objects, tools, and controls while reaching with hands and arms
* Frequently required to stand, communicate, and listen
* Occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel or crouch
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Able to perform repetitive movements
* Able to work in variable temperatures (cold/hot)

**Company Overview**
Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.
 
 
**EEO**
Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

records.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.
 
 
L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.
 
 
***Job Title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering***
***Job Code: 47622***
***Job Location: Camden, AR***
***Job Schedule: 4/10: Employees work 10 hour days, 4 days a week***
**Job Description:**
The Manufacturing Engineering Director in Camden, Arkansas will plan, organize and technically direct the manufacturing engineering activities and staff. Enable Operations to execute all programs in a safe and efficient manner, and ensuring the achievement of quality, cost and delivery schedule objectives. This position reports to the Senior Director Operations and Site Management. Our Camden, AR site is at $600M+ revenue and produces a diverse portfolio of highly engineered products for aerospace and defense applications. The individual will be responsible for implementing a disciplined operating system in line with the enterprise while improving the operating effectiveness of the site and leading an organization of over 190 people.
 
 
**Essential Functions:**

* 50% - Direct and lead technical team: Analyze, evaluate and determine appropriate solutions for manufacturing technical problems encountered in the application of manufacturing methods, facilities and processes. Apply engineering procedures, provide technical direction, create and apply work instructions and tooling for the factory floor. Participate in program and site corrective action boards and be a key member in customer escape and non-conformance investigations; develop direct cause, root cause and mistake proof corrective actions, as well as separation criteria when required. Ensure proper deployment of resources to achieve cost effective results in support of site and business unit deliverables. Direct the installation of Electronic Work Instructions (Platform is DELMIA) across the site and all product lines. Strict oversight of the Job Safety Analysis and Process Safety Management programs at the site.
* 15% - Administrative management: Ensure a safe work environment and remain in compliance to federal and local regulations. Develop long range technical and administrative plans, goals and strategies.
* 15% - Customer interface: Establish priorities to meet the needs of the customer and the organization with a dedication to support the manufacturing shop floor. Represent the organization as a prime internal and customer contact on manufacturing technical operations.
* 20% - Strategy and Continuous Improvement: Lead the sites Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) program. Drive operational

excellence throughout the organization and create a metrics driven, highly accountable mindset within the organization.
 
 

* Ability to obtain a US secret security clearance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 15 years prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 13 years prior relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 19 years of prior relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated supervisory and leadership skills, including planning, organizing and directing activities; developing talent; and collaborating across business units and functional teams to achieve site objectives.
* Strong understanding of business development, program management, engineering, finance, operations and process control, with the ability to engage effectively with plant-floor teams, customers and executives.
* Experience in aerospace and/or general industrial sectors, including multiple years in a leadership capacity, with program management, engineering leadership and experience with inert, energetic and propellant materials.
* High-energy, results-driven leader with a disciplined work ethic, a bias for action and a continuous improvement mindset. Able to drive commitments to closure, elevate performance and lead organizational change in a demanding environment with lean staffing.
* Ability to satisfy federal government requirements for access to government information.

L3Harris Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. L3Harris is committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity and maintaining a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, characteristic or membership in any other group protected by federal, state or local laws. L3Harris maintains a drug-free workplace and performs pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks, where permitted by law.
 
 
Please be aware many of our positions require the ability to obtain a security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens. In addition, applicants who accept a conditional offer of employment may be subject to government security investigation(s) and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
 
 
By submitting your resume for this position, you understand and agree that L3Harris Technologies may share your resume, as well as any other related personal information or documentation you provide, with its subsidiaries and affiliated companies for the purpose of considering you for other available positions.
 
 
L3Harris Technologies is an E-Verify Employer. Please click here for the E-Verify Poster in English or Spanish. For information regarding your Right To Work, please click here for English or Spanish.
