records.title: Director Operational Excellence Site Leader
records.description:
**Job Description**
**Honeywell Aerospace**
is a leading provider of innovative aerospace products and services. Our products and solutions are found on virtually every commercial, defense, and space aircraft in the world. We are committed to delivering cutting-edge technologies that enhance the safety, efficiency, and performance of the aerospace industry. Our aerospace business unit encompasses a wide range of products and services, including aircraft engines, cockpit and cabin electronics, wireless connectivity systems, mechanical components, and more. We are at the forefront of advancements in aviation technology, constantly pushing the boundaries to create healthier air travel, more fuel-efficient aircraft, and safer skies.
 
 
With our high-speed Wi-Fi offerings, we enable seamless connectivity for passengers and crew, enhancing the in-flight experience and enabling real-time data transmission. Our solutions also contribute to more direct and on-time flight arrivals, improving overall travel efficiency. In addition to our core products, we provide value-adding services such as maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) to ensure the continued reliability and performance of aerospace systems. Our facilities and expertise support the Federal government and agencies, further strengthening our position in the aerospace industry.
 
 
At Honeywell Aerospace, we are committed to sustainability and environmental responsibility. We strive to develop technologies that reduce emissions, improve fuel efficiency, and minimize the environmental impact of aviation. With revenues of $17.5 billion in 2025 and approximately 21,000 employees globally, we are a key player in the aerospace industry. Our dedicated team of professionals works tirelessly to introduce state-of-the-art technology solutions that drive efficiency, productivity, and safety in high-growth businesses.
 
 
As an
**Aerospace Operating System Site Leader**
here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will be a critical leader in the development and site-wide deployment for the Aerospace Operating System (AOS), driving the transformation of operational performance across the site or multi sites.
 
 
You will partner closely with Site Leader and AOS Global Operations Leader to establish the AOS roadmap, align strategic priorities, and enable scalable implementation across functions within the site including but not exclusive to planning, materials, sourcing, and quality.
 
 
As the key thought leader and change agent, this individual will coach leaders, drive method development and continuous improvement initiatives, and optimize end-to-end supply chain processes spanning procurement, planning, production, distribution, and logistics to support long-term growth, operational efficiency, and cultural transformation.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinates, prioritizes & organizes improvement events and AOS courses to create value for the unit
* Manages or leads relevant, strategic & operational business challenges
* Fosters a continuous improvement mindset with respective methods and tools
* Supports and/or orchestrates the Hoshin Kanri process for the site
* Supports and/or orchestrates productivity generation activities
* Coaches peers & key managers inside the unit on the promotion & use of AOS
* Acts as a thought leader for an Agile & Lean mindset
* Advances AOS through sharing of success stories & recognition of stakeholders
* Orchestrates, coaches & leads AOS community & key enablers
* Drives, motivates & manages AOS qualifications of employees
* Active member of the global, companywide AOS community
* Collaborate with the AOS office to execute the AOS strategy

**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 8+ years of practical application of Lean Manufacturing and Operating Systems principles and tools
* 8+ years of project management experience gained through both strategic and tactic change projects
* Business fluent in local language and English
* Experience influencing and communicating effectively with frontline employees, site leadership, and senior executives, including leading cross-functional initiatives and presenting business outcomes to leadership teams.
* Ability to travel to other locations for training or project support (limited)

**WE VALUE**

* A bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* A Master of Business Administration is a plus
* Experience in various areas of operations is strongly preferred, i.e. production, planning, procurement, logistics or similar
* Successful track record in leading without formal authority
* Proven experiences in driving results & coaching teams/peers across departments
* Experience in developing and sustaining networks / communities
* Leadership qualities & experience in motivating and developing diverse teams
* 8 Years of Practical experience facilitating improvement events
* Ability to Inspire & lead without authority
* Alignment to Honeywell Aerospace values, behaviors and principles, with experience and focus on customer outcomes, transformation, innovation, end-to-end ownership, and teamwork
* Ability to be an active listener and empathetic
* Experience convincing & pro-active change driver
* Passionate about learning Aerospace OS Core Methods and tools
* Results & quality orientation
* Methodical & structured way of thinking
* High analytical capability

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.
 
 
**Benefits**
Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
 
 

* Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
* Employee assistance program and educational assistance
* Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
* Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/
 
 
**POSTING TIMELINE**
The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**SUMMARY**

Leads enterprise clinical quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and performance improvement initiatives to improve outcomes, drive operational excellence, and support strategic growth. Partners with clinical and operational leaders to establish quality standards, oversee governance and accreditation activities, implement data-driven improvement strategies, and advance innovative quality solutions that enhance organizational and client success.

**GENERAL HOURS OF WORK:** Monday through Friday (with occasional night and weekend involvement)

 

**REPORTS TO:** Chief Operating Officer

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

*Clinical Quality Leadership*

* Leads accreditation readiness, regulatory compliance, quality reporting, and corrective action planning activities.
* Leads the development and execution of enterprise-wide clinical quality, patient safety, and performance improvement strategies.
* Partners with physician and operational leaders to establish quality goals, drive accountability, and improve clinical outcomes.
* Coordinates and oversees quality improvement initiatives across all clinical programs and service lines.
* Monitors, analyzes, and reports quality performance metrics, benchmarks, and outcome trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Maintains quality policies, procedures, governance structures, and documentation standards.
* Supports clinical governance, risk management, peer review, and professional practice evaluation processes.
* Facilitates physician quality committees and multidisciplinary improvement teams.
* Promotes a culture of continuous improvement, evidence-based practice, and provider accountability for quality outcomes.

*Performance Improvement & Operational Excellence*

* Identifies workflow variation, standardization opportunities, and best practices to improve outcomes and operational performance.
* Implements and sustains process improvement efforts that reduce variation, improve reliability, and enhance patient experience.
* Partners with operational leaders to improve patient experience, clinical performance, and organizational effectiveness.

*Strategic Quality Engagement*

* Develops and executes Avel's enterprise quality and clinical transformation strategy.
* Designs and operationalizes scalable quality improvement services, frameworks, and methodologies for customers.
* Establishes quality and outcomes measurement as key components of Avel's value proposition and market differentiation.
* Serves as a trusted advisor to clients on quality strategy, patient safety, outcome improvement, and regulatory excellence.
* Identifies emerging healthcare quality trends and incorporate best practices and innovation into Avel solutions.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Health Care field required.

* Master's degree in healthcare or business administration preferred
* 10+ years of experience in medical staff office functions, quality, compliance, risk management and performance improvement required.

**ABOUT AVEL eCARE**

Avel eCare is a nationally recognized leader in virtual health, operating one of the most extensive virtual healthcare networks in the world. Based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, Avel partners with more than 650 health systems, rural hospitals, clinics, and facilities to deliver innovative telehealth solutions. Our services span Behavioral Health, Critical Care, Emergency, Hospitalist, Pharmacy, Specialty Clinic, Senior Care, and School Health — impacting nearly two million patients annually.

For three decades, Avel has been at the forefront of healthcare innovation, developing telehealth solutions that reduce costs, save time, and remove barriers to quality care. Join our mission-driven team and help reshape the future of healthcare.

**MISSION**

"We transform access to high-quality healthcare for people and communities through integrated virtual solutions."

**VISION**

"Setting the standard for healthcare delivery by creating the nation’s most trusted Virtual Health System, through innovation and partnership."

records.description:
**Location: St. Paul, MN | Columbia, MD | Charlotte, NC (Hybrid)**

In this position, you'll be based in one of the listed office locations for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for some of your working week. Find out more about our flexible work culture at computershare.com/flex.

**We give you a world of potential**

Technology plays a critical role in helping Computershare deliver secure, resilient, and innovative solutions for clients around the world. Within our Corporate Trust technology organization, we're investing in the future of quality engineering and building a modern, engineering-led approach to quality that is deeply embedded within the software development lifecycle.

We're looking for a strategic and transformational Head of Quality Engineering to lead the evolution of quality engineering across Corporate Trust Technology. This role will define the quality engineering vision, operating model, standards, tooling, governance, and automation strategy while partnering closely with engineering, product, architecture, security, and business leaders.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of quality engineering across a global technology organization, lead large distributed teams, and drive the adoption of automation-first and AI-assisted testing practices at scale.

**A role you will love**

As the Head of Quality Engineering, you'll be responsible for establishing and executing the quality engineering strategy across Corporate Trust Technology. You'll help transform quality from a traditional quality assurance function into an engineering-led discipline focused on automation, continuous testing, risk reduction, and delivery excellence.

This role is ideal for a technology leader who enjoys influencing at scale, driving organizational change, building high-performing teams, and improving engineering outcomes across multiple delivery organizations.

**Other key responsibilities include:**

* Defining and executing the quality engineering vision, strategy, and operating model across Corporate Trust Technology.
* Leading quality engineering transformation initiatives and organizational change efforts.
* Driving automation-first testing strategies and Playwright adoption.
* Establishing enterprise quality standards, governance frameworks, policies, and reporting practices.
* Defining quality metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and continuous improvement processes.
* Leading and developing globally distributed quality engineering teams across onshore and offshore locations.
* Sponsoring adoption of AI-assisted testing, quality analytics, and intelligent automation capabilities.
* Providing executive oversight of quality outcomes, delivery risk, defect trends, and production incidents.
* Partnering with engineering, product, architecture, risk, compliance, and security teams to align quality practices with business objectives.
Building sustainable quality engineering capabilities through coaching, workforce planning, learning pathways, and succession planning. 

**What will you bring to the role?**

Required:

* Enterprise-scale quality engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading quality engineering transformation initiatives.
* Strong automation expertise, particularly with Playwright.
* Experience establishing quality standards, governance frameworks, and engineering best practices.
* Experience supporting Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD delivery environments.
* Experience managing global and offshore technology teams.
* Strong understanding of test automation, quality engineering frameworks, software delivery lifecycle governance, and continuous testing practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior technology and business stakeholders. 

Preferred:

* QA-to-QE transformation experience.
* AI-assisted testing experience.
* Financial services technology experience.
* Experience leading Centers of Excellence or shared services organizations.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, Veracode, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience supporting enterprise modernization or digital transformation programs.
Experience working within regulated or compliance-driven environments. 

**Rewards designed for you**

**Paid parental leave,** flexible working and a caring and inclusive culture.

**Health and wellbeing rewards** that can be tailored to support you and your family, including medical, dental and vision.

**Invest in your future** with 401k matching and tax-advantaged flexible spending plans, including healthcare, dependent care and commuter.

**Income protection** . Our package includes short and long-term disability benefits, life insurance and supplemental life insurance.

**Compensation:** The typical base pay range for this role is $124,568.00 - 155,000.00 for Columbia, MD and St Paul, MN. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

**And more.** Ours is a welcoming and close-knit community, with experienced colleagues ready to help you grow. Our careers hub will help you find out more about our rewards and life at Computershare, visit computershare.com/careershub .

records.title: Director, Quality & EHS
records.description:
**SCOPE OF POSITION:** 
Directs the strategic oversight and continuous improvement of the organization’s manufacturing Quality Management System (QMS) to achieve operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

 

**CONSTRUCTION SPECIALTIES, INC.**

Founded in 1948, Construction Specialties (CS) is a specialty building products manufacturer. CS provides solutions to building challenges that architects, designers, building owners, facility managers, and contractors face every day. Since inventing the first extruded louver, CS has become a global leader in all our product categories. Our products are a part of some of the most iconic buildings around the world– from the world’s tallest tower, Burj Khalifa in Dubai, to the Oculus at the World Trade Center Transit Hub in Manhattan. If you want to work in an inspiring atmosphere and collaborate with customers and colleagues to solve challenges, we're the right place for you. CS: People. Buildings. Better.

 

*Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans.*

 

**KNOWLEDGE/ SKILLS/ EXPERIENCE/ EDUCATION:** (Minimum Education and/or Experience required)

* Strong leadership and team-building skills, strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred.
* 6 years in QMS leadership with demonstrated experience leading a quality system.
* Managing and Leading through Influence
* Ability to travel up to 50%
 

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Problem Solving
* Process Improvement
* Quality Assurance Process
* Total Quality Management (TQM)
* Strategic Planning
* Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Processes 

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* yes

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, including but not necessarily limited to the following:*

* Develop, maintain and optimize global QMS strategy and processes based on relevant regulatory requirements and aligned with corporate goals.
* Establishes quality governance frameworks, performance metrics, and audit systems to monitor compliance and drive consistent process improvement.
* Partners with senior leadership to integrate quality objectives into overall business planning and customer satisfaction initiatives.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing QMS team. Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and collaboration within the team and across the organization.

records.title: Director of Program Quality
records.description:
**Job Summary**

CLA seeks an experienced leader to oversee CLA’s Quality Program. Supervise the Quality Assurance Professional, Certified Professional Trainers, Community Case Management Program Manager, RN Association Nurse/CCM Clinical Supervisor, and Shared Living Coordinator, providing supports for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. The person in this role will review Quality Improvement Systems, monitor and direct audits of service quality and compliance, and act as the steward of policies, conventions, and forms used in Active Treatment. This person will supervise quality and content of training; organize and schedule training, and market training outside of CLA. Research, review, and support compliance with applicable state and federal licensing and program rules, laws, and regulations. As a member of the senior leadership team, the Director of Program Quality will work collaboratively with the Executive Director and peers for the best interest of the entire organization and mission.

​Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Social or Human Services, Special Education, or related field and 4 years’ experience working with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Progressively more responsible administrative, fiscal, supervisory, and management experience. Proven success in assisted living, health care, or social service setting. Excellent written, interpersonal, verbal communication, and computer skills; ability to prioritize, organize, and manage multiple tasks effectively.

**Skills**

* Healthcare or IDD quality assurance experience, team leadership, and project management experience in healthcare; demonstrated process improvement and compliance management capabilities.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Work Location: In person

records.title: Corporate Director of Quality
records.description:
Take the next step with an exciting and growing company
 
As the only fully integrated maker of premium quality wire, rope, and assemblies, Loos & Co holds a leading position in the global aerospace sector.
 
A division of the Central Wire (CWI) Group of Companies encompassing 12 locations in three countries, 750+ employees, and over six decades of excellence, Loos & Co solutions are found in mission critical flight control applications. Our precision-manufactured components are also used for defense, med tech, and heavy industry purposes around the world, in large part because of the people behind our products.
 
Do you have a strong work ethic? Take pride in a job well done? Are you passionate about contributing to individual and team, company and customer successes? If you’re interested in joining a dynamic work environment that offers opportunities to reach your full potential, we want to hear from you.
 
 
Position Summary / Essential Function
 
The Corporate Director of Quality is CWI’s senior enterprise Quality leader and is responsible for establishing and sustaining a culture of quality excellence, accountability, customer focus, product safety, and continuous improvement across aerospace, commercial, medical, metal rope, and assembly facilities. Based in Pomfret Center, Connecticut and reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director leads the enterprise Quality function, develops high-performing teams of Quality professionals, and establishes the governance, systems, standards, metrics, and decision rights required for consistent execution across all locations.
 
A central responsibility of the role is to create a results- and data-driven culture in which decisions are based on objective evidence, process capability, customer and regulatory requirements, risk, and measurable business outcomes. The Director advances the organization from reactive inspection and problem resolution toward prevention, disciplined problem solving, statistical thinking, robust corrective action, and sustained operational excellence.
 
The Director maintains the effectiveness and certification readiness of applicable quality management systems, including AS9100D and ISO 9001 for aviation, space, defense, and commercial operations; ISO 13485 for medical-device operations where applicable; and customer-, product-, and facility-specific requirements for metal rope, wire rope, cable, and assemblies. The role ensures that customer and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements take precedence where they exceed or conflict with general quality-system requirements.
 
Key Responsibilities
 

* Build, lead, develop, and retain a high-performing organization of Quality professionals across CWI, with clear roles, decision rights, measurable objectives, development plans, succession pipelines, and performance expectations.
* Create a results- and data-driven culture of Quality excellence in which teams use objective evidence, trend analysis, statistical methods, and risk-based thinking to identify priorities, prevent defects, and verify sustained improvement.
* Establish and execute the enterprise Quality strategy, organizational design, staffing plan, technical roadmap, and resource priorities in alignment with CWI business and operating objectives.
* Own enterprise governance for quality management systems and maintain certification readiness for applicable aerospace, commercial, medical, metal rope, and assembly facilities, including registrar, customer, regulatory, and internal audits.
* Ensure aerospace quality controls address AS9100D requirements, including operational risk management, configuration management, product safety, counterfeit-parts prevention, special-process control, production process verification, foreign-object damage prevention, traceability, and awareness of ethical behavior.
* Ensure first article inspection and production process verification practices align with AS9102 when contractually applicable, and ensure special processes are qualified, controlled, and approved to customer, regulatory, or other requirements where applicable.
* Ensure medical quality-system controls align with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory and customer requirements, including risk management, validated processes, traceability, complaint handling, CAPA, change control, and record retention.
* Establish common standards for document and record control, calibration, inspection and test, nonconforming output, CAPA, root-cause analysis, internal auditing, management review, supplier quality, customer complaints, product and process change control, and continuous improvement.
* Establish an enterprise Quality performance-management system with leading and lagging indicators for customer complaints, escapes, first-pass yield, scrap and rework, cost of poor quality, supplier defects, audit findings, process capability, CAPA aging, recurrence, and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Lead monthly operating reviews and formal management reviews that convert Quality data into executive-level insights, identify systemic and emerging risks, assign accountable owners, and track actions through verified closure.
* Develop Quality leaders who can influence Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams; make risk-based decisions; escalate product-safety or conformity concerns; and hold the organization accountable for results.
* Serve as the senior Quality escalation point for significant customer complaints, product escapes, product-safety events, audit findings, systemic nonconformances, supplier-quality issues, and certification or regulatory risks.
* Ensure robust containment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, effectiveness verification, and lessons-learned deployment for significant or recurring failures, including consideration of human factors where relevant.
* Provide enterprise oversight for supplier-quality strategy, supplier qualification, risk-based surveillance, source inspection, flow-down of customer and regulatory requirements, and supplier corrective action.
* Partner with the Chief Operating Officer, Plant Managers, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Commercial, and other leaders to integrate Quality into operational performance, new-product introduction, manufacturing transfers, and change management.
* Communicate Quality-system health, certification status, customer performance, material risks, resource needs, and improvement results clearly to executive leadership and the Board or ownership group when requested.
* Perform other related duties consistent with the role, grade, and business needs.

Required Qualifications
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Metallurgy, Quality, Manufacturing, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Twelve or more years of progressive Quality, manufacturing, engineering, or operational leadership experience in regulated or high-reliability manufacturing.
* At least seven years of direct people-leadership experience, including leadership of Quality managers and professionals, performance management, coaching, organizational design, and succession planning.
* At least five years of multi-site or enterprise Quality leadership experience with accountability for common systems, audits, metrics, and cross-site standardization.
* Demonstrated responsibility for an AS9100D-certified quality management system and successful participation as the senior Quality leader in at least one third-party certification or recertification cycle.
* Demonstrated experience with internal and external audit programs, management review, CAPA, root-cause analysis, configuration and change control, supplier quality, product safety, traceability, nonconformance control, and customer complaint resolution.
* Demonstrated use of Quality data and statistical methods to improve performance, including examples of measurable reduction in defects, escapes, cost of poor quality, or recurring corrective actions.
* Ability to travel approximately 25% to 40% to CWI facilities, customer sites, supplier sites, and audit locations, with additional travel during significant launches, audits, or quality events.
* Ability to communicate technical and business risk, priorities, decisions, and performance clearly to plant, functional, customer, registrar, and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications
 

* Experience in specialty metals, wire, cable, wire rope, aircraft cable, mechanical cable, swaging, metal assemblies, or other highly engineered metal products.
* Experience leading Quality in aerospace and defense manufacturing, including customer flow-downs, AS9102 first article inspection, source inspection, special processes, counterfeit-parts controls, configuration management, product safety, and foreign-object damage prevention.
* Experience with ISO 13485-certified medical-device manufacturing and risk-management practices aligned with ISO 14971 where applicable.
* Experience with Nadcap-accredited special processes, Defense Contract Management Agency oversight, Federal Aviation Administration-regulated products, or major aerospace prime and Tier 1 customer requirements, as applicable to CWI’s business.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Operations, Quality, or Business Administration.
* Experience using an electronic QMS, ERP, business-intelligence, and statistical software to manage Quality performance and traceability.

Preferred Certifications
 

* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) or equivalent senior Quality leadership credential.
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or AS9100 Lead Auditor certification.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt.
* Certified Manufacturing Engineer, Professional Engineer, Project Management Professional, or comparable technical credential as relevant.

Key Leadership Competencies
 

* Enterprise Quality leadership and culture building
* Leadership, development, and retention of Quality professionals
* Results orientation and measurable accountability
* Data-driven decision making and statistical thinking
* AS9100D, ISO 9001, and regulated quality-system leadership
* Product safety, compliance, and risk-based judgment
* CAPA, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action effectiveness
* Customer quality and executive escalation
* Cross-functional influence and change leadership
* Continuous improvement and operational excellence
* Executive communication and management review
* Multi-site governance and standardization

Leadership Standard
 
Success in this position is measured not simply by maintaining certifications or passing audits, but by the Director’s ability to build capable Quality leaders and teams, establish measurable accountability, improve the effectiveness of CWI’s quality systems, reduce recurring failures and customer escapes, strengthen process capability, protect product safety and conformity, and demonstrate sustained improvement through objective performance data.
 
Physical and Work Environment Requirements
 
The role operates in office and active manufacturing environments and requires regular interaction with plant operations. It may require walking or standing on production floors, observing machinery and manufacturing activities, using a computer and quality information systems, and communicating in areas where hearing protection or other personal protective equipment is required. Travel among company locations, customer sites, supplier sites, and audit locations is expected. Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law. This description identifies the essential functions of the position but is not intended to list every physical activity or working condition.
 
Base Salary Range
 
$142,000-$204,500
 
Benefits
 
Subject to the terms, eligibility requirements, and amendment provisions of the applicable plans and policies:
 

* 401(k) with matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Pre-Employment Drug Testing
 
All applicants who are offered a position with the Company will be required to successfully complete a post-offer drug screening, where permitted by applicable law and in accordance with Company policy.
 
At-Will Employment
 
Employment with the Company is at will. Either the employee or the Company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law. Nothing in this job description creates a contract of employment or alters the at-will employment relationship.
 
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
 
The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination or harassment based on any protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law.
 
 
**Benefits:** 

* Health, Dental and Vision insurance options
* Life insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Employee assistance program
* Employee Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement

**Shift:** 8-hour shift
 
**Work Location:** In person, Company does not provide relocation assistance.
 
Central Wire Group of Companies is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.
 
Central Wire Group of Companies is a Drug-free workplace and pre-employment drug tests and background checks are required.

records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
**Job Details**
---------------

**Job Title: Director, Quality**

**Location: Meriden, CT**

**Work Arrangement:** Onsite

**About the Role**
------------------

**The Director of Quality** provides leadership, direction, and support to the Quality team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus. This role is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and consistent manufacture, validation, and delivery of chemical products while maintaining the highest standards of quality and operational excellence. As a leader of the Quality Team, the Director coaches, develops, and empowers team members to achieve individual and departmental goals, build technical expertise, and drive continuous improvement across the organization. The Director also ensures timely and effective management of quality-related communications, processes and programs that support both customer satisfaction and business growth. Working closely with colleagues across Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Sales, and Customer Service, the Director of Quality establishes and maintains robust quality systems, drives regulatory compliance, and identifies opportunities to improve processes, reduce risk, and enhance product integrity. Through strong leadership and partnership, this role helps ensure customer requirements are met, supports the company's commitment to safety and quality, and contributes to the organization's long-term success and reputation in the marketplace.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Provide leadership for functional area
* Establish and ensure Quality policies, standards, and objectives ensuring best practices through benchmarking and collaboration with regional and corporate colleagues
* Drive overall compliance ensuring on-time completion of key deliverables
* Responsible for document control, SOP’s, master training schedule, Certificates of Conformance, review and approve relabel PITAs etc.
* Review and approve all quality reports such as annual product review, temperature mapping, validation, internal audit, etc.
* Conducting timely audits, management reviews batch review and release, supply chain, supplier and product qualification
* Advises leadership on quality risks, compliance matters, and strategic quality improvement opportunities
* Driving continuous improvement and risk assessment initiatives
 

**Decision-Making and Problem Solving**

 

* Establishes and approves quality policies, procedures, standards, and quality objectives
* Makes final decisions regarding product release, product disposition, and quality-related exceptions
* Determines appropriate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) in response to quality events, customer complaints, audit findings, and nonconformances.
* Decides when production processes, materials, or products fail to meet quality or regulatory requirements and may halt production or shipment when necessary
* Evaluates and approves supplier quality programs, qualification processes, and remediation plans
* Recommends investments in quality systems, laboratory capabilities, technology, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Serves as the organization's lead authority during regulatory inspections, customer audits, and significant quality incidents

**Skills**
----------

* Ability to drive Quality focus throughout the organization
* Strong strategic thinking and problem solving skills
* Experience in developing and maintaining Quality Management Systems
* Expertise in Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
* Demonstrated ability in leading and managing audits and regulatory inspections
* Strong leadership and decision-making capabilities
* Ability to manage large teams and projects
* Strong communication and influencing skills
* Change management

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biology, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related scientific discipline required
* Master's degree in a related field preferred
* 7 - 10 years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Quality Systems, or Regulatory Compliance within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or regulated chemical manufacturing industry
* 5+ years of people leadership experience managing and developing professional teams
* Experience leading Quality Management Systems (QMS) within a cGMP-regulated environment
* Demonstrated experience interacting with regulatory agencies, customers, and external auditors

**About Caldic**
----------------

At BrandNu, a Caldic Company, we’re a global leader in distribution solutions, serving diverse markets across the world. Joining us means becoming part of an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and innovation-driven team.

 

**We offer:**

* Competitive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, legal, 401(k) with company contributions, paid time off and more
* An inclusive, diverse, and dynamic work environment
* The chance to shape the future of specialty ingredient solutions across industries like food, pharma, personal care, and more

We operate in 43 countries around the world. Our innovative solutions are tailored to meet the needs of industries such as food, pharma, personal care, and industrial markets, ensuring sustainable success for all stakeholders. To learn more, visit: www.caldic.com

 

**Ready to Join Us?**

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and join a global leader, apply now at BrandNu Laboratories, a Caldic company!

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Caldic celebrates diversity and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, or any other characteristic.

records.title: Director, Data & AI Governance, Quality & Assurance
records.description:
As an employee of Boehringer Ingelheim, you will actively contribute to the discovery, development, and delivery of our products to our patients and customers. Our global presence provides an opportunity for all employees to collaborate internationally, offering visibility and the opportunity to directly contribute to the company's success. We realize that our strength and competitive advantage lie with our people. We support our employees in several ways to foster a healthy working environment, meaningful work, mobility, networking, and work-life balance. Our competitive compensation and benefit programs reflect Boehringer Ingelheim's high regard for our employees.
 
 
The head, Data & AI Governance, Quality & Assurance is accountable for data & AI trust, quality, transparency, compliance, and responsible use across data products, AI products, analytical assets, and agents within the U.S. organization. The role owns U.S. governance frameworks, controls, quality and assurance standards, stewardship expectations, and independent oversight across the lifecycle, aligned with applicable global policies and standards.
 
 
The Data & AI Governance, Quality & Assurance sets acceptance criteria, identifies and escalates material risks, provides evidence for accountable decisions, and drives adoption of AI and agentic workflows to modernize data and AI governance, quality, and assurance across the U.S. organization.

 

This role is based on-site at our Ridgefield, CT location with hybrid flexibility of 2-3 days per week on-site.

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Owns the U.S. Data & AI governance and assurance framework, aligned with global policies and standards.
* Defines policies, standards, controls, and accountability structures.
* Sets data quality, stewardship, observability, and assurance expectations.
* Governs metadata, catalog, lineage, access, permitted use, and information-management policy.
* Governs KPI, business-rule, ontology, semantic, and AI or agent registration processes.
* Defines responsible AI controls and independent validation criteria.
* Provides independent lifecycle oversight and risk-acceptance recommendations.
* Builds governance, quality, stewardship, and assurance capability.
* Drives adoption of AI and agentic workflows to modernize data and AI governance, quality, stewardship, and assurance processes.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Data Science, Computer Science, Law, Risk, Quality, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field required.
* MSc, MBA, JD, or relevant graduate degree; governance, risk, audit, quality, privacy, security, or responsible AI credentials are advantageous preferred.
* Twelve-plus (12+) years of relevant experience, including senior leadership in governance, risk, compliance, quality, assurance, or information management within a complex U.S. organization.
* Demonstrated success establishing governance frameworks, decision rights, controls, stewardship models, and independent assurance across complex organizations.
* Deep knowledge of data quality, metadata, lineage, catalogs, access, permitted use, observability, issue management, and control evidence.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI, model and agent governance, lifecycle controls, registration, validation, monitoring, and release assurance.
* Demonstrated success redesigning governance and quality processes and driving adoption of AI and agentic workflows, with measurable improvements in effectiveness, efficiency, transparency, and user experience.
* Ability to maintain independence from remediation while providing practical findings, thresholds, and risk recommendations.
* Strong analytical judgment, executive communication, regulatory influence, and escalation capability.
* Ability to lead through a matrix, align control functions and delivery teams, and build governance and stewardship capability.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life-sciences, healthcare, or another highly regulated environment.
 

**Eligibility Requirements** :

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without restriction.
* Must be willing to take a drug test and post-offer physical (if required).
* Must be 18 years of age or older.

records.description:
**Help shape the clinical future of one of the region's most respected healthcare organizations.**

Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care is seeking an experienced Advanced Practice Provider leader to serve as **APP Medical Director, Quality & Safety**.

The Medical Director reports to the Chief Medical Officer and provides direct leadership to an assigned group of providers and Lead Providers, while holding network-wide responsibility for clinical quality standards, quality surveillance, patient safety, and performance improvement across Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care. This senior leadership position combines meaningful clinical practice with the opportunity to advance evidence-based care and strengthen clinical performance across a growing network in Connecticut and New York.

**Why Join Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care?**

* Regional leadership opportunity with impact across urgent care centers throughout Connecticut and New York.
* Partnership with an experienced and collaborative medical leadership team.
* Ability to influence clinical quality, safety, and provider performance at scale.
* Opportunity to mentor providers and develop future clinical leaders.
* Strong operational infrastructure and organizational support.
* Continued clinical practice while serving in a senior leadership role.
* Proudly affiliated with Yale New Haven Health.

**A Regional Leadership Opportunity**

Working collaboratively with the Chief Medical Officer, fellow Medical Directors, Lead Providers, and operational leaders, the APP Medical Director, Quality & Safety will translate clinical performance data, quality findings, and emerging risks into meaningful improvements in care delivery, provider performance, and patient outcomes.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide direct leadership, performance management, coaching, and professional development for an assigned group of Advanced Practice Providers.
* Directly supervise and develop assigned Lead Providers, supporting their effectiveness in provider oversight, clinical escalation, and quality improvement.
* Lead network-wide clinical quality and patient safety initiatives, including quality surveillance, clinical event review, clinical risk identification, and performance improvement.

* Establish and oversee chart review, documentation integrity, coding accuracy, and provider feedback processes, ensuring findings translate into appropriate corrective actions and measurable improvements in clinical care.

* Develop and monitor evidence-based clinical standards, including diagnostic testing, clinically significant results follow-up, referral and escalation processes, and adherence to established clinical protocols.

* Partner with the Chief Medical Officer and operational leadership on clinical governance, regulatory readiness, and risk mitigation.

* Maintain meaningful clinical practice while serving in a leadership capacity.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful leader in this role will:

* Demonstrate measurable improvements in clinical quality, patient safety, and provider performance across the urgent care network.

* Develop and support high-performing providers and Lead Providers through effective coaching, accountability, and professional development.

* Use clinical performance data, chart review findings, and quality metrics to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and sustain results.

* Foster consistent, evidence-based care and a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across geographically diverse teams.

* Champion a patient-centered approach to urgent care that supports timely access, appropriate clinical management, and seamless coordination across the Yale New Haven Health delivery network.

**Qualifications**

* Current unrestricted PA or APRN licensure and appropriate board certification.
* Significant urgent care clinical experience with expertise managing the broad range of acute illnesses, injuries, and procedures encountered in urgent care practice.
* Substantial clinical leadership experience, including direct provider supervision, performance management, accountability for clinical quality and patient safety outcomes, and successful implementation of measurable clinical improvement initiatives.
* Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience leading across multiple clinical sites and utilizing quality and performance data to drive improvement strongly preferred.
* Ability to travel throughout the region as needed to support providers, quality initiatives, and operational priorities.

**Working Arrangement**

* This is a regional, multi-site leadership position supporting Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care locations throughout Connecticut and New York. The position is not assigned to a single clinical site and requires travel throughout the network.
* Clinical Commitment: 0.3 FTE.
* Medical Leadership Responsibilities: 0.7 FTE.

**Ready to Take the Next Step?**

If you're an accomplished Advanced Practice Provider with a passion for clinical leadership, quality improvement, and patient safety, we invite you to explore this opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the Yale New Haven Health Urgent Care network.

**Apply today to learn more.**

records.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!

**Job Description**

**Location:** Simsbury, CT

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Industry:** Aerospace & Defense

**Experience Level:** Director (15+ years)

**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**

At **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),** we’ve been innovating for nearly **200 years,** delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.

We’re seeking a dynamic **Director of Quality** to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.

**The Opportunity:**

EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.

**Core Competencies for Success:**

* **Quality & Compliance Leadership:** Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.

* **Continuous Improvement & Performance:** Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* **Team Development & Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* **Resilience & Adaptability:** Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* **Legacy:** Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* **Impact:** Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* **Partnership:** Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* **Culture of Excellence:** Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.

**Compensation and Rewards:**

We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:

**Base Salary:** $175k – $225k plus annual bonus

**Executive Relocation:** Comprehensive support for a seamless transition

**Additional Enhancements:** Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience

*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*

*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

records.description:
### **Activités**

**SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering, manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information. The incumbent is responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets in accordance with company policies and customer requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Analyzes, evaluates, and presents information concerning factors such as quality performance, production capabilities, manufacturing problems, customer quality trends, and quality planning of new products for consideration by other members of the management team.
* Presents and evaluates alternative methods and procedures to establish standardized quality systems based on best practices.
* Participates with other top management personnel in formulating and establishing company policies, operating procedures, and goals.
* Participates in review of product development activities and APQP milestones.
* Conducts Quality System Management review meetings with top management to assess performance and compliance to customer quality requirements.
* Reviews technical problems and procedures of departments and recommends solutions to problems or changes in procedures.
* Confers with engineers and managers about quality assurance of new products and process to improve manufacturing capability.
* Reviews technical publications, articles, and abstracts to stay abreast of technical and quality system developments in industry.
* Travel required on a frequent basis to suppliers and customer facilities as well as other Hutchinson facilities.
* Provides internal quality system audit of Hutchinson Sealing Systems locations.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

Master's degree (M.A.) or equivalent; or four to ten years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Qualifications may be waived by management. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**

None.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Manages subordinates in department. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complains and resolving problems.

**TEAM SKILLS:**

Hutchinson is built around teamwork. This position requires the use of good team skills such as cooperation, information sharing, task sharing, timely completion of assignments, good listening and communication skills and overall respect for other team members.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to write speeches and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups and/or boards of directors.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**COMPUTER SKILLS:**

Ability to use word processing, spreadsheet applications. Must be familiar with internet research, Microsoft Office software, and the use of e-mail.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close, vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**HEALTH AND SAFETY:**

Must actively support our Health Safety and Environmental policy, immediately report all Safety hazards and correct them when able to safely do so, participate in all required Safety Training, meetings, inspects, and use all required PPE.

records.title: Production Director
records.description:
The Production Director leads all signage manufacturing operations, including fabrication, wide-format printing, finishing, assembly, production quality and installation. This leader is accountable for meeting customer commitments, maximizing production capacity, controlling costs, and achieving departmental financial objectives. 
This is a high-accountability leadership role requiring operational expertise, financial discipline, and a growth mindset. The Director will build a high-performing team, establish clear expectations, improve productivity, eliminate bottlenecks, and ensure the department can scale efficiently as Strategic Factory grows. 
The objective is to deliver exceptional quality, flawless execution, and profitable growth through strong leadership, disciplined processes, and measurable results. 
Essential Responsibilities1. Financial Performance and Profitability

* Own departmental performance against revenue, gross margin, labor, material, and profitability targets.
* Monitor job costing, estimated versus actual labor, material usage, overtime, waste, and rework to protect margins.
* Establish cost controls and identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce expenses, and increase throughput.
* Align staffing, equipment, purchasing, and production capacity with work orders, forecasts, and company growth objectives.
* Partner with the VP of Signage, Finance, Sales, and Project Management to ensure production decisions support company-wide financial goals.

2. Production Leadership and Execution

* Lead all daily signage production operations, including fabricated signs, channel letters, dimensional signage, wide-format printing, finishing, and assembly.
* Own production scheduling, workflow, capacity planning, and on-time completion.
* Establish clear priorities, deadlines, and ownership across production teams.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Project Management, Purchasing, and Installation to ensure projects move efficiently from order to completion.
* Identify constraints early, resolve production issues quickly, and maintain visibility into work in progress, material availability, and equipment utilization.
* Ensure production commitments are realistic, communicated, and consistently achieved.

3. Leadership and Accountability

* Build and develop a high-performing team focused on urgency, quality, teamwork, and results.
* Establish clear roles, measurable expectations, and accountability for supervisors and production employees.
* Hold team leaders accountable for schedules, staffing, productivity, quality, safety, and financial performance.
* Coach and develop supervisors to solve problems, make decisions, and own their results rather than relying on constant intervention.
* Address performance issues promptly, recognize strong performance, and ensure appropriate training and staffing.
* Foster a positive, high-energy culture that values continuous improvement, direct communication, and follow-through.
* Leadership standard: Set expectations, provide the tools to succeed, measure results, coach consistently, and hold people accountable.

4. Quality and Customer Satisfaction

* Establish quality standards for all fabricated, printed, and finished signage.
* Ensure work meets approved artwork, engineering specifications, material requirements, and customer expectations.
* Track defects, rework, scrap, and customer complaints; implement corrective actions to prevent recurring problems.
* Partner with Project Management and Installation to resolve issues and protect customer commitments.
* Promote a customer-first mindset in which quality, communication, and on-time delivery drive retention and future revenue.

5. Operational Excellence and Growth

* Continuously improve workflows, production methods, standard operating procedures, and equipment utilization.
* Eliminate bottlenecks, unnecessary handling, downtime, waste, and inefficient labor practices.
* Develop a scalable production plan aligned with sales forecasts and annual revenue goals.
* Identify staffing, equipment, facility, and technology investments needed to support growth, with clear financial justification.
* Make disciplined in-house versus outsourcing decisions based on cost, capacity, quality, and delivery.
* Use production data and performance scorecards to identify trends, assign corrective actions, and measure results.

6. Materials, Equipment, and Safety

* Manage material planning, inventory accuracy, purchasing coordination, and supplier performance.
* Control material waste and ensure supplies are available to meet production schedules without unnecessary inventory.
* Oversee preventive maintenance and ensure equipment is operated and maintained properly.
* Maintain a safe, organized production environment and enforce company safety policies and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Ensure required training, maintenance records, and safety procedures are consistently maintained.

7. Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

* Provide regular reporting on financial performance, production schedules, capacity, staffing, quality, and operational risks.
* Communicate schedule changes, material shortages, and customer delivery risks proactively.
* Work collaboratively with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Purchasing, and Installation to achieve company objectives.
* Support leadership decisions, communicate priorities consistently, and focus on solutions rather than excuses.

The Director will be evaluated against established company targets, including:

* Financial: Revenue achievement, gross margin, labor costs, and departmental profitability.
* Execution: On-time delivery, schedule adherence, throughput, and production cycle time.
* Quality: Rework, scrap, defects, and customer complaints.
* Productivity: Labor efficiency, overtime, equipment utilization, and capacity.
* Growth: Ability to increase production volume while controlling costs and maintaining quality.
* Leadership: Staffing, employee development, accountability, and performance improvement.
* Operational discipline: Material waste, inventory accuracy, safety, and completion of improvement initiatives.
 
* **Requirements**

 

* 7-10 years of progressive experience in sign manufacturing, fabrication, wide-format printing, or a related production environment.
* At least 5 years of leadership experience managing production teams and preferably multiple production functions.
* Demonstrated experience with fabricated and printed signage, production scheduling, workflow management, and quality control.
* Proven ability to manage job costs, labor, materials, capacity, and profitability.
* Track record of improving productivity, quality, on-time delivery, and financial results.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience with ERP/MIS systems, production reporting, and performance metrics.
* Knowledge of equipment maintenance, workplace safety, and manufacturing best practices.
* Relevant degree preferred; equivalent experience and demonstrated results will be considered.

records.title: Senior Director, Master Data Management & Operations

postedPay.title: Senior Director, Master Data Management & Operations

records.description:
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you—innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.
 
 
**Led by Purpose. Driven by You.**

 
 

The Senior Director, Master Data Management & Operations (MDM) will lead the enterprise master data capability. They will establish clear ownership and operating discipline so that critical business data is accurate, trusted, and ready to support the business.

 

Reporting to the VP Data & AI, the Senior Director, MDM will lead a global team of 65 with three direct reports focused on 1) functional data domains 2) engineering and tooling 3) supporting transformation and operations.

 

This leader will play a central role in a multi-year enterprise transformation and integration agenda, ensuring master data is ready to support major system and business changes. They will balance near-term delivery priorities with the long-term target state, while supporting existing systems alongside modern governance platforms; as well as focus on:

 

* **End to End master data ownership**: Own master data across all functions, regions, and business segments. Establish clear accountability, decision rights, and drive decisions and escalations.
 

* **Integration and program delivery**: Lead master data readiness for large-scale enterprise integration and transformation efforts. This includes integration experience, comfort operating at scale in a matrix, and the ability to influence senior business leaders across the company.
 

**Role & Responsibilities**
 
The Senior Director, MDM serves as a key transformational leader who will be responsible for:

**Enterprise Master Data Strategy**

* Define and own the enterprise master data strategy, setting a clear direction for how master data will be owned, governed, and used to run the business with confidence.
* Establish the operating model and talent strategy needed to manage master data end to end.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to align priorities, investments, and capabilities to enterprise objectives.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for master data, translating data strategy into measurable business outcomes.
 

**Engineering & Tooling Ownership**

* Own the master data engineering and tooling agenda, setting the target-state architecture and roadmap for master data platforms, integrations, and supporting tools.
* Drive standardization and simplification of the master data tooling landscape, rationalizing redundant and legacy tools in favor of common enterprise platforms.
* Use tooling to drive efficiency, consistency, and simplification of master data processes, embedding standards, data quality rules, and governance directly into the workflow.
Drive intelligent automation of master data processes, applying workflow automation, AI, and machine learning to reduce manual effort, accelerate cycle times, and improve data quality. 

**Enterprise Integration & Transformation**

* Lead master data readiness for large-scale enterprise integration and transformation programs.
* Oversee master data enablement for ERP transformation, including harmonization, integration, and migration efforts.
* Balance near-term delivery priorities with the long-term target state.
Support existing systems alongside modern governance platforms as the enterprise transitions. 

**Business Partnership & Influence**

* Collaborate with senior business and technology leaders across the enterprise to align master data capabilities to critical business domains.
Influence in a matrix environment, driving decisions and escalations rather than acting as a subject matter expert or order taker. 

**Functional Leadership**

* Develop a global, multi-disciplinary team spanning domain ownership, technology and tooling, and program operations.
* Coach and mentor leaders, attracting top talent and creating an environment where data professionals do their best work.
Integrate teams and capabilities through shared priorities, standards, and operating rhythms. 

**Experience We're Looking For:** 
 
The Senior Director, MDM will have a proven track record leading master data at large, global organizations, with deep expertise across master data management, data quality, stewardship, governance, integration, and data product ownership. This leader will ideally bring experience in CPG or adjacent, complex consumer-oriented industries such as Pharmaceuticals, Retail, or Manufacturing, including exposure to regulated or restricted products. Experience in mergers, acquisitions, and large-scale enterprise integration is highly valued. Familiarity with enterprise ERP environments and modern master data governance platforms is helpful.

Equally important is the ability to operate as a strategic, influential leader who can partner with senior business and technology leaders, drive decisions and escalations, and influence in a large, matrixed organization. The Senior Director, MDM will be comfortable with complexity and change, able to set clear direction for a global team. They will bring strong execution, attention to detail, and a collaborative, action-oriented leadership style, with a record of building, coaching, and mentoring high-performing teams.

**Functional Skills & Experience**

* Deep expertise in master data management, governance, data quality, stewardship, standards, and adoption.
* Proven success owning master data end to end across functions, regions, and business segments.
* Experience leading M&A, enterprise integration, and ERP-enabled master data harmonization, migration, and consolidation.
