records.description:
**About Momentive Technologies**

Momentive Technologies applies advanced materials science to design and manufacture ultra-high-performance quartz materials, quartz crucibles, and ceramic products that are vital to a variety of high-growth end markets, including the silicon and compound semiconductor industries, electronics, and aerospace components. These solutions enable the production of logic and memory chips, power control devices and multiple systems for electric vehicles, integrated circuits, power control devices, data servers, and aerospace applications.

Recognized for the purity, performance, consistency and stability of its products, Momentive Technologies has been delivering innovative solutions for over 130 years and continues to impact emerging trends like electrification, digitalization, renewable energy and artificial intelligence. The Company, headquartered in Strongsville, Ohio, has operations across the globe and serves customers in more than 30 countries. For more information, visit www.momentivetech.com

**Director Global Quality**

The Director, Global Quality is a highly visible leadership role responsible for shaping and advancing quality strategy across our global organization. Serving as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, this individual will provide insight into quality performance, requirements, risks, and opportunities while driving greater consistency and excellence across operations in the United States, Germany, South Korea, China, and Japan.

This leader will champion continuous improvement, strengthen quality systems and processes, and identify opportunities to enhance both operational performance and customer satisfaction. Equally important, the Director will lead, mentor, and develop quality leaders across the regions, creating an engaged, accountable, and collaborative global Quality organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead the global Quality and QMS strategy, establishing standardized processes, governance, performance expectations, and accountability across global sites and product lines while ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, customer-specific, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish global quality standards and drive QMS harmonization, reducing unnecessary site-to-site variation and deploying common approaches for CAPA, nonconformance, change management, risk management, audits, document control, and management review.
* Lead global quality performance and continuous improvement, using quality trends, COPQ, yield, customer complaints, escapes, and systemic risk to prioritize improvement initiatives, allocate resources, and deliver sustainable improvement in quality and business performance.
* Own the global strategy for supplier and critical material quality, establishing standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, performance management, auditing, corrective action, and development to strengthen supplier capability and reduce risk to product quality and supply continuity.
* Provide leadership for significant customer, supplier, and product quality escalations, ensuring effective containment, root-cause investigation, corrective action, and systemic prevention while protecting customer relationships and business continuity.
* Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Technology, and Commercial leadership to integrate quality requirements and risk management into sourcing decisions, manufacturing strategy, new products, process changes, and capacity expansion.
* Build global quality capability and organizational effectiveness, coaching Quality Leaders, facilitating deployment of best practices across sites and product lines, and strengthening technical competency, problem-solving discipline, training, talent development, and succession planning.
* Monitor emerging customer expectations, industry requirements, technologies, and external quality practices, translating relevant developments into the global quality strategy, QMS, supplier quality approach, and continuous improvement priorities.

**Basic Qualifications**

 

* A minimum of 10 years’ of experience in Quality Assurance or similar Quality role.
* 5+ years Leadership Experience directing a Professional Team, preferably on a global level.
* Strong proficiency in ISO 9001 and AS 9100 quality standards
* Outstanding organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage many projects or programs simultaneously.
* Possess a communication style that builds strong relationships at all levels of the organization and impacts outcomes and decisions.
* Demonstrated strong analytical expertise coupled with effective presentation, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
* Possess transformational leadership qualities – ability to engage, inspire, challenge and influence others and without formal authority.
* Experience in working with ERP systems, preferably SAP.
* Strong knowledge of problem solving and analytical tools such as 8-D, RCCA, SPC or similar
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, preferably chemical industry or glass industry

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Prior experience leading a global quality organization
* Expert knowledge of SAP QM functional module
* Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt Certification
* ISO9001 and AS9001 internal auditor or lead auditor certifications

**Travel Requirements:**

* 15-20%

**Total Rewards**

Our **Director Global Quality** will earn a variable compensation including base salary and bonus. Base salary range takes into consideration experience, education, and training. Not to mention all the amazing benefits available for employee selection as well.

**Joining the Momentive team includes:**

* Medical/Prescription Drug Coverage
* Dental Coverage
* Vision Coverage
* 401(k) plan with Company Match
* Basic and Voluntary Life/AD&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Program
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Referral Program

Momentive Technologies is not just shaping materials; we're shaping the future. As a leader in the fused quartz, ceramics, and crucibles industry, we pride ourselves on innovation, precision, and excellence. When you join us, you'll be part of a dynamic team that's driving advancements in technology, research, and applications across various sectors. **APPLY NOW!**

**EEO Statement**

We treat all our associates and candidates as equals. We require all associates and managers to do so too and comply with employment laws and regulations. All personnel actions are conducted in the spirit of equal employment. We are committed to recruit, train, promote and retain associates without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

**Accessibility Guidelines**

We are committed to making the on-line application experience easy and accessible to individuals with disabilities. We are constantly making improvements to comply with the spirit of the "Americans with Disabilities Act," and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines. If any of the information on the website is not accessible to you due to a disability, please contact us via phone at (440) 878-5739. Please provide the location of the inaccessible information and the format you wish to have the information presented and we will be happy to send it to you, either via your email address or a separate mailing address you provide. If you prefer, you may contact us and we will be happy to assist you with the application process.

records.title: Head of Production, Supply Chain & Continuous Improvement

postedPay.title: Head of Production, Supply Chain & Continuous Improvement

records.description:
At Alloy Precision Technologies, we unite advanced manufacturing with hands-on mastery to deliver for our customers—and create meaningful growth for our people. Lead the engine room of our business and amplify impact across operations.

**Your mission**
----------------

* Own the production, supply chain, maintenance, planning, and warehouse ecosystem—drive flow, reliability, and cost discipline.
* Build systems that make performance visible: schedule adherence, on-time delivery, throughput, and quality.
* Elevate safety and environmental performance through visible leadership and clear standards.
* Institutionalize lean practices and business process improvements that reduce waste and improve profitability.
* Publish clear, actionable reports that inform decisions across the organization.
* Set annual targets and programs for manufacturing, service, and distribution that align with strategy.
* Ensure outcomes meet customer expectations and comply with AS9100 and applicable regulations.
* Travel domestically and internationally as required to support operations and partner engagements.
* Take on additional priorities as assigned by the President and Chief Executive Officer.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Plan, coordinate, and control day-to-day operations across all manufacturing services.
* Diagnose and resolve production delays and constraints via structured problem solving.
* Strengthen cross-functional communication to align objectives and remove friction.
* Coach and mentor leaders; cultivate a culture of empowerment, accountability, and teamwork.

**Team leadership**
-------------------

* Directly lead group leaders, supply chain, and production planning; adapt org structure as needs evolve.
* Execute people processes in accordance with APT policies and all applicable laws: hiring, training, work assignment, performance management, recognition, discipline, issue resolution, and career growth.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BS in Operations Management, Industrial Management, Industrial Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years in manufacturing management; exposure to precision welding (TIG, laser, brazing, soldering), CNC/manual machining, and light assembly is beneficial.
* Advanced skills with Microsoft Office; experience with databases/ERP (e.g., Visual Manufacturing) and establishing labor standards for cost models is advantageous.
* High-energy, results-driven leadership with exceptional interpersonal skills; able to influence at every level.
* Strategic, proactive, and persistent; effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
* Flexible, resilient, and growth-oriented within an evolving culture; dedicated to excellence and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated lean manufacturing capability required; Six Sigma background is a plus.

records.title: Director of Integrated Fab Manufacturing
records.description:
Bold Thinking. World Changing. At SkyWater, our ingenuity helps improve lives around the world by manufacturing U.S. made semiconductors that are essential ingredients of modern life. Automotive safety enhancements, life-saving medical devices, consumer electronics and American security require semiconductors. Working in our Minnesota headquarters, Florida, or Texas location — employees join together to improve the world.
 
 
Explore what’s possible. Joining our U.S. - based team means contributing to and learning about the commercialization of some of the most exciting technologies the world has ever seen. We are turning “science fiction” into everyday reality through technologies such as superconducting, 3D integrated circuits or computer chips, carbon nanotubes, photonic logic devices, micro electro-mechanical systems and other emerging device topologies. We manufacture products for aerospace and defense, medical, automotive, consumer and industrial markets, to name a few. Our customers include emerging leaders who rely on our intellectual property security and quality manufacturing services.
 
 
Step into the future. SkyWater’s values of Integrity, Excellence, Collaboration, Empowerment and Growth Mindset guide us to cultivate an empowered, learning environment. We also invest in developing highly skilled, dedicated employees — and employees who are entering the workforce for the first time, from the military, and a variety of educational backgrounds.
 
 
Are you bold thinking? Find your place on our team and help us change the world!
 
 
**Primary Objective:** 
Join an innovative semiconductor manufacturing organization at the forefront of advanced technology and manufacturing excellence. The Director of Integrated Fab Manufacturing owns the operational, financial, and strategic leadership of the Bloomington fabrication facility, including the Advanced Technology Services (ATS) Process Engineering Technician team. This role ensures the factory achieves world-class safety, quality, output, cycle time, and cost performance while directing a 24/7 organization and partnering across engineering, planning, and quality teams to meet all customer and business commitments.
 
In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end operational execution, strategic planning, budgetary ownership, and leadership to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient semiconductor manufacturing. You will be responsible for driving absolute excellence across safety, quality, output, cost optimization, and ensuring smooth production flow to consistently meet internal and external customer quality and on-time delivery (OTD) commitments, and fab velocity metrics / key performance indicators (KPIs).
 
The successful candidate will own the organizational design and talent strategy for their organization, serving as a role model and lead a highly matrixed organization consisting of the Manufacturing team, Process Engineering Technicians group, and Flow Engineers. This role is expected to partner closely with Program Managers, Technical Leads, Wafer Planning, Manufacturing, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and Technology Development teams to improve operational performance, resolve manufacturing constraints, and deliver business objectives. This leader will play a critical role in transforming factory capabilities to meet strict customer commitments and flexible demand by influencing long-range capacity and setting standards for the MN fab operations organization.
 
 
**Major Areas of Accountability:** 

* Operations Leadership: Lead the daily and long-term operational execution in the fab, as well as the ATS technician and flow engineer teams to meet all production starts, output targets, yield expectations, cycle time goals, and quality standards, including setting clear priorities for the organization. Direct, develop, and coach the 24/7 operations teams—including Production, ATS Process Engineering Technicians, and Flow Engineers—to ensure capability, accountability, and organizational readiness.
* Team Leadership: Lead, develop, and empower the Production team, Process Engineering Technicians and Flow Engineers to provide effective manufacturing support, maintain production continuity, and resolve process and workflow issues
* Budgetary Responsibility: Own the fab operating budget, including labor, materials, maintenance, and operational spending; drive cost-reduction initiatives and evaluate capital investments using ROI-based decision-making.
* Wafer Planning and Customer Delivery: Partner with Wafer Planning and Program Management to align schedules, capacity, and customer priorities; identify delivery risks and oversee recovery plans to maintain on time delivery (OTD) performance.
* Manufacturing Performance: Partner with Industrial Engineers, and drive continuous improvement in throughput, cycle time, WIP management, yield, quality, equipment availability, and manufacturing cost using data-driven decision-making and structured problem-solving.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and Technology Development to resolve production constraints, improve equipment readiness, and maintain stable manufacturing operations.
* Operational Excellence: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including customer OTD, cycle time, throughput, equipment availability, and quality. Promote standardization, disciplined execution, effective escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Talent Development: Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, collaboration, and development of technical and operational talent. Responsible for the organizational design and talent strategy of these teams, with a focus on cultivating and retaining key talent, developing future leaders and preparing current leaders for the next level role.

**Required Qualifications:** 

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related technical discipline.
* Experience: Minimum 12 years in semiconductor manufacturing or operations; minimum 5+ years leading fab operations in a senior manager or director capacity within a 24/7 manufacturing environment.
* Skills:
* Demonstrated ability to improve manufacturing performance (throughput, cycle time, yield, cost, and customer delivery).
* Expertise in wafer planning, WIP management, or production scheduling.
* Strong capability in statistical process control (SPC), structured problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated leadership with large technical teams, with an ability to communicate and collaborate cross-functionally, delivering results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Proven track record of managing a 24/7 manufacturing organization and guiding cross-functional teams through technical tool or yield crises.
* Citizenship: US Citizen required.

**Physical Requirements:** 

* Ability to enter the cleanroom in full PPE to provide technical and operational support.
* Ability to navigate multi-level fab environments, including prolonged walking and standing when needed.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.
 
 
**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* Education: Master’s or PhD in a relevant technical discipline.
* Experience: Deep knowledge of advanced Complimentary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) nodes, fab toolsets (Lithography, Etch, Diffusion, Thin Films, Chemical Mechanical Polish, Metrology, Metals), and factory automation systems.
* Skills: Experience driving major manufacturing transformations, automation or digitization initiatives, or large-scale capacity improvements.

The annual salary range for this role is $159440 - $239,160. Pay offered is based on many factors, including, but not limited to, the job-related experience, skills, education, and credentials of each candidate.
 
 
SkyWater offers an exciting environment where the brightest semiconductor minds come together to achieve exceptional results. We offer competitive salary and an opportunity to participate in incentive plans as well as other employee financial benefits, including 401k match, and life insurance.
 
Additionally, SkyWater offers a comprehensive benefits package which promotes a healthy life. This includes benefit eligibility day one, medical, dental, mental health benefits, vision, legal planning, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid holidays, an on-site fitness facility, and an on-site self-serve market.
 
SkyWater complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities unless doing so would cause an undue hardship. Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. To request reasonable accommodations, to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources at 952-851-5200 or Recruiting@SkyWatertechnology.com.
 
EOE, including disability/vets
 
We will never ask applicants to pay fees, purchase equipment or gift cards, or provide financial information before a formal offer of employment has been accepted. If you receive a suspicious communication claiming to represent our company, please verify its authenticity by contacting our recruitment team at recruiting@skywatertechnology.com before responding.

records.title: Director of Operations - Proliant Dairy Ingredients - Ankeny, Iowa
records.description:
Proliant Dairy Ingredients is committed to providing the best dairy ingredient options for enhancing the value and effectiveness of our partners’ products. We are formulating success by living our values of Continuous Improvement, Teamwork, Quality, and Leadership. 
 
The Director of Operations provides strategic leadership and oversight of the company’s manufacturing operations, quality, and process engineering functions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and supporting overall organizational performance and growth. As a member of the PDI leadership team, this position works closely with the CEO and senior leadership to drive business growth, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS:**
-----------------------

Education:

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* BS or MBA in operations management, engineering, or dairy and/or food science preferred.

 

Experience:

* Demonstrated leadership ability with strong interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
* Minimum eight years of experience required, with at least five years of production/operations management experience.
* Experience within dairy industry or food processing highly preferred.

**JOB DUTIES:**
---------------

* Lead the development and implementation of operational strategies, policies, and processes to drive efficiency and organizational effectiveness within manufacturing operations.
* Lead and oversee all aspects of employee management for the operations, quality, and process engineering departments, including recruiting, hiring, training, work assignment, performance management, employee development, recognition, and discipline. Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate market opportunities and develop recommendations to drive business development and company growth.
* Support raw material sourcing strategies, assist in securing reliable supply commitments, and maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure supply continuity and alignment with business objectives.
* Oversee workplace safety across all PDI U.S. production facilities, ensuring safe working conditions are maintained, and appropriate corrective actions are implemented when necessary.
* Responsible for overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of U.S. production facilities. Keep up to date on dairy processes and techniques.
* Interact, visit, and communicate with various vendors regarding necessary changes to improve operations at all plants.
* Identify areas for improvement in the plants, determine courses of action, and implement improvements and corrective actions in these areas.
* Develop plans for supply and efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Review production costs and product quality, maximize yields, modify production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of all U.S. Operations.
* Research and assess the viability of new technologies to improve operations.
* Participate in strategic planning process by reviewing PDI operations and recommend budgets for both raw material and capital expenditures.
* Submit necessary requests for capital investment in accordance with established budgets, process, and return-on-investment requirements; present capital investment projects to President & CEO and as necessary to the PDI leadership team.
* Ensures fundamental food safety and quality practices are maintained to achieve food safety and quality objectives and supports ongoing improvements of food safety programs.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**
---------------------

* Knowledge of manufacturing, engineering, and operations principles and ability to apply those principles to production management function.
* Ability to effectively communicate and work with management and across multiple departments, as well as with customers and other business contacts.
* Ability to maintain and manage corporate confidential information as well as confidential customer information.
* Knowledge of organizational methods and the ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously.
* Ability to assist with special or ongoing projects as instructed by senior management.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret professional journals, technical procedures, or government guidelines.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from internal individuals/groups, suppliers, customers, and the public.
* Ability to analyze data and utilize to drive optimization and problem solving.
* Strong leadership ability in creating a team environment.
* Ability to think strategically and at the same time solve practical problems across a variety of situations.
* Ability to travel as needed to meet job duties (approximately 50%).

**BASIC PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**
--------------------------------

Approximate: 8 - Hour Day (may be longer, dependent on business needs)

**Key:**

Occasional = 0% to 33%

Frequent = 34% to 66%

Continuous = 67% to 100%

N/A = Not Applicable

Sitting - Frequent

**Working on Heights:**

Operating a Vehicle (as a part of your job) - Occasional

Read/Monitor Gauges on Various Equipment/Machinery - Occasional

**Hand Movements:**

Recording Data - Occasional

Operating Office Equipment - Occasional

Operating Computer - Frequent

Simple Grasping (right and left) - Occasional

Office - Frequent

Rough Terrain - Occasional

Other - N/A

**BASIC MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:**
------------------------------

This position requires the mental capabilities to apply technical knowledge surrounding the production and operation of manufacturing plants. Furthermore, the incumbent must assimilate and disseminate operational information, develop plans, and forecast future supply and production trends.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND EXPOSURES:**
-------------------------------------

Position located in Iowa. Occasional travel (international and domestic) to include spending time in two production plants and laboratory locations (Michigan and Minnesota) and headquarters in Iowa.

**COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS:**

* A choice of three quality affordable healthcare coverage options
* Vision coverage
* Dental coverage
* Health savings account with employer contribution/flexible spending accounts
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off starting at 3 week/annual and 9 paid holidays

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation due to a disability at any stage of the employment application process should contact human resources (515)-289-5161.*

records.title: Senior Director, Merchandise Manufacturing & Sourcing
records.description:
**Job Description:**
====================

NOTE: This role is based in New York City and encourages a minimum of two days per week in the SoHo office. Some roles or teams may require additional in-office attendance if the essential functions of the role require it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Director, Merchandise Manufacturing & Strategic Sourcing is a key global leadership role responsible for the strategic sourcing, manufacturing, commercialization, and production execution of Scholastic's merchandise portfolio supporting Book Fairs, Book Clubs, Trade Publishing, Discovery Fairs, and future consumer product initiatives.

Reporting directly to the SVP Manufacturing who is responsible for Global Supply Chain and Procurement, this position serves as the critical bridge between Product Development, Editorial, Design, Category Management, Publishing, and global manufacturing partners.

This leader partners with internal stakeholders from the earliest stages of product ideation, providing expertise in product engineering, sourcing strategy, manufacturing capabilities, material selection, cost optimization, and production feasibility. The objective is to transform creative concepts into high-quality, innovative products that deliver exceptional customer experiences while achieving aggressive cost, quality, and speed-to-market objectives.

The role oversees a global sourcing portfolio exceeding $200 million annually and leads an international team of approximately 12 professionals located across the United States and India. The position may be based in the United States, China, or India and requires extensive collaboration with domestic and international suppliers and manufacturing partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

**Product Development, Ideation & Publishing Partnership**

* Serve as a strategic partner to Publishing, Editorial, Design, Category Management, Book Fairs, Book Clubs, Trade, and other stakeholders to translate creative concepts and intellectual property into compelling, manufacturable products.
* Engage early in product ideation, bringing manufacturing and sourcing expertise to decisions around materials, formats, construction, packaging, features, price points, and production methods.
* Proactively introduce new product concepts, materials, manufacturing capabilities, and supplier innovations that expand Scholastic's product opportunities.
* Partner throughout the development cycle from concept, specification, prototyping, sampling, and costing through pproval and production.
* Challenge and improve concepts where appropriate to enhance consumer appeal, quality, manufacturability, sustainability, speed, and cost.

**Consumer Products & Sourcing Strategy**

* Lead development of the sourcing and manufacturing strategy supporting Scholastic's expanding consumer-products and merchandise initiatives.
* Partner with business and publishing leadership to identify new product categories and opportunities across Book Fairs, Discovery Fairs, retail, e-commerce, licensing, and other emerging channels.
* Develop category sourcing strategies addressing manufacturing regions, supplier capabilities, cost, lead times, minimum quantities, tooling, quality, and supply-chain risk.
* Build a proactive pipeline of product ideas and manufacturing capabilities that can be regularly presented to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of consumer trends, emerging categories, materials, and manufacturing technologies and translate those insights into actionable product opportunities.

**Global Vendor Development & Innovation**

* Proactively identify and develop innovative manufacturers and product-development partners, particularly those offering engineering expertise, rapid prototyping, unique materials, creative capabilities, and new manufacturing technologies.
* Develop suppliers that can function as extensions of Scholastic's product-development organization, proactively bringing forward new concepts and capabilities.
* Continuously evaluate the supplier portfolio to improve competitiveness, increase speed, diversify supply, reduce risk, and enable entry into new categories.

**Global Sourcing, Cost & Operational Leadership**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive global sourcing strategy supporting more than $200 million in annual product expense.
* Establish sourcing roadmaps and supplier-diversification strategies that anticipate future business requirements and reduce dependency on individual suppliers or regions.
* Ensure products consistently meet expectations for quality, safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, cost, and on-time delivery.

**Supplier Engagement & Global Travel**

* Maintain direct senior-level engagement with strategic manufacturing partners and regularly visit supplier facilities to evaluate capabilities, innovation, quality, capacity, and operational performance.
* Significant international travel is expected, with consistent travel to Asia, particularly China and India, as well as other global sourcing markets as required.
* Use supplier visits as product-development and innovation opportunities to identify new materials, manufacturing processes, capabilities, and product concepts for Scholastic.

As the world's largest publisher and distributor of children's books through school-based book clubs and book fairs, classroom libraries, school and public libraries, retail, and online, and with a global reach into more than 135 countries, Scholastic encourages the personal and intellectual growth of all children, while nurturing a lifelong relationship with reading, themselves, and the world around them. records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Location:

Garden City, NY, US, 11530

Business Unit: Treitler FMH

Posting Date: Nov 20, 2026

Job Description:

**Position Summary:**

The Director of Operations is responsible for leading Hughes-Treitler operations to achieve business objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and customer satisfaction. This hands-on leadership role provides strategic and day-to-day direction for manufacturing, materials, and operational excellence while ensuring the organization has the talent, capacity, processes, and resources required to support current demand and business growth. The Director establishes operating plans, drives accountability, builds organizational capability, and leads continuous improvement initiatives that improve performance, expand capacity, control costs, and strengthen customer responsiveness.

 

**Supervisory Responsibilties:**

The position has direct reports but must be able to work in partnership with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Production in support of the departmental objectives. 



**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop Operations teams to effectively support day-to-day execution, strategic business objectives, customer requirements, and growth plans.
* Establish operating strategies, objectives, budgets, capital requirements, material plans, labor requirements, and organizational priorities aligned with customer and business needs.
* Ensure the organization is structured and staffed with the talent, resources, and capabilities needed to meet customer quality, technical, delivery, and turnaround-time expectations.
* Partner with business leadership to achieve key performance indicators, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, throughput, backlog reduction, customer lead time, productivity, labor utilization, cost, and profitability.
* Lead the development and execution of the site Lean and Operational Excellence roadmap, using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, TPM, SIOP and daily management practices to improve flow, yield, cycle time, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and monitor operating standards, performance metrics, and management routines that drive accountability, timely problem-solving, and sustained results.
* Drive capacity planning and expansion initiatives, including capital equipment, automation, facility, tooling, staffing, and process investments required to support business growth.
* Manage operating expenses and capital investments in accordance with approved budgets; identify and execute cost-reduction and productivity opportunities.
* Ensure effective planning and control of materials, inventory, suppliers, production schedules, and labor resources to support quality, cost, and delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with Quality, Engineering, Sales, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to resolve operational issues, support new product introductions, strengthen manufacturability, and meet customer requirements.
* Provide leadership for robust root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and customer performance.
* Participate in the development and execution of the business strategy and translate strategic priorities into actionable operating plans and measurable objectives.
* Support commercial and customer-facing activities, including operational reviews, pricing and capacity analyses, customer visits, and performance presentations.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain operations talent through performance management, career development, succession planning, cross-training, and ongoing capability building.
* Foster a culture of accountability, employee engagement, collaboration, innovation, safety, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Author annual performance reviews and develop continuing education and advancement paths for entire department.
* Demonstrate the ability and willingness to use AI tools appropriately to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and cost performance, including identifying suitable use cases and critically evaluating AI-generated outputs.
 

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong leadership, project management, analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations and continuous improvement initiatives in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency with Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to establish performance metrics, analyze operating data, prioritize competing demands, and drive accountability for results.
* Proven ability to lead change, manage multiple complex initiatives, and meet critical deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional interpersonal, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build effective work relationships.
* Strong customer orientation and demonstrated ability to balance customer requirements with operational, financial, and organizational priorities.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure, exercise sound judgment, and maintain a hands-on leadership presence across the operation.
* Proficiency with enterprise resource planning and manufacturing systems; experience with SIOP or related planning processes preferred.
* Demonstrated history of successful change management and implementation of operational excellence improvements.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership and organizational skills and the ability to communicate with all levels of the organization from the production floor to the executive office.
* Willingness to work a flexible schedule and travel as needed to support business requirements.
 

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or another related technical discipline required; MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing operations leadership experience in a low-volume/high-mix, build-to-order, or engineered-products environment; experience in aerospace, defense, metal-forming, precision machining, brazing, welding, or another highly regulated industry preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading salaried and hourly employees.
* Demonstrated experience leading Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and continuous improvement programs with measurable results.
* Demonstrated experience driving operational planning, capital and capacity expansion, production and materials management, cost optimization, organizational improvements, and customer-facing operational reviews.

**Other:**

* Due to the nature of Hughes-Treitler's programs and products, applicants must have the legal right to work in the US and additionally must be legally authorized to access export-controlled information and source code.

**Compensation**
----------------

Employee Type: Salaried

Currency: USD

Salary Minimum: 200,000

Salary Maximum: 225,000

Incentive: No

Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.

For more information on AMETEK's competitive benefits, please click here.

AMETEK, Inc. is a leading global provider of industrial technology solutions serving a diverse set of attractive niche markets with annual sales over $7.5 billion.

AMETEK is committed to making a safer, sustainable, and more productive world a reality. We use differentiated technology solutions to solve our customers’ most complex challenges. We employ 22,000 colleagues, in 35 countries, that are grounded by our core values: Ethics and Integrity, Respect for the Individual, Inclusion, Teamwork, and Social Responsibility. AMETEK is a component of the S&P 500. Visit https://www.ametek.com/careers for more information.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process should call 1 (866) 263-8359.

records.title: Plant Manager - Louisville
records.description:
**Plant Manager**

**Who we are:** 
Atkore is forging a future where our employees, customers, suppliers, shareholders, and communities are building better together – a future focused on serving the customer and powering and protecting the world.

With a global network of manufacturing and distribution facilities, Atkore is a leading provider of electrical, safety and infrastructure solutions.

 

**Who we are looking for:** 
We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to be based out of Louisville, KY. Reporting to the Vice President Operations, this person will be responsible for directing and managing plant operations for extrusion processing, maintenance, quality, and shipping/receiving. This position will coordinate plant activities through the planning with departmental managers to ensure the total manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a safe, timely and cost-effective manner.

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore. Experience in lean manufacturing or business system-based company is a requirement.

**What you’ll do:**

* Provide direction, development and leadership for the facility and share best practices with other Plant Managers in running a safe, productive, cost-effective plant
* Establish and monitor overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
* Implement cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages and salaries.
* Participate in regular P&L reviews to ensure that budgets are met; develops and implements programs for optimal equipment utilization, equipment maintenance, and labor and material costs
* Control and minimize labor overtime, premium freight and repair expenses.
* Provide leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Maintain existing plant facilities and equipment; replace or make adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Manage capital asset maintenance.
* Implement and maintain preventative maintenance programs.
* Provide Safety and Health direction and support to personnel; ensures compliance with OSHA and environmental regulations.
* Incorporate shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
* Demonstrate and promote our key Atkore values of Accountability Teamwork, Integrity, Respect, and Excellence, through actions and decisions.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore.
* Working knowledge of budgets and financial statements.
* Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.
* Advanced knowledge and experience of PVC Water pipe extrusion process preferred.
* Ability to implement Lean Manufacturing practices and drive continuous improvement.
* Six Sigma / Project Management experience.
* Excellent written and communications skills
* Computer literate. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Proven experience as a mentor/developmental manager for employees
* Available to occasionally work off shift to provide training and facilitate continuous improvement initiatives to all production shifts.
* Ability to work both as a member of a team, a team leader or as an individual contributor.
* Experience managing in a matrixed, mid-to-large organization
* All associates must embrace and foster and environment that supports our core values of Integrity, Respect, Excellence, Teamwork and Accountability.

 

**Within 3 months, you’ll:**

* Complete your Atkore Immersion and training requirements.
* Understand how your job will help deliver Atkore’s strategy.
* Gain an understanding of your team.
* Have developed relationships with the key stakeholders for this role.
* Be well-versed in Atkore’s Business System and the importance of your role to daily operations.

 

**Within 6 months, you’ll:**

* Maintain and be accountable for KPI visual reporting while actively participating in Lean Daily Management activities, including GEMBA walks.
* Create and modify standardized work and ensure consistent application by all team members.
* Hire talent into your organization, coach and manage performance of your team members and compensation management responsibilities for direct reports.
* Identify ways to strengthen the team’s commitment to Atkore’s core values of Accountability, Teamwork, Integrity, Respect and Excellence.

 

**Within 12 months, you’ll:**

* Be managing an efficient plant and team that delivers Atkore’s strategy.
* Have meaningful performance conversations with your direct reports.
* Be able to resolve any issues quickly and safely.

Atkore is a seven-time Great Place to Work© certified company and a three-time Top Workplaces USA award winner! We’re committed to creating an engaged and aligned workforce driven by a collaborative culture. We consistently live the Atkore mission, strategic priorities, and behaviors, consistent with our core values.

**Join our team and align yourself with an industry leader!**

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay for this position is $128,080 - $176,110. Placement in the range depends on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, relevant experience, skills, seniority, performance, shift, travel requirements, and business or organizational needs and may change over time. Other compensation may include, but not limited to, overtime, shift differentials, bonuses, commissions, stock, and other incentives.

Benefits available include:

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance
* Life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* 401k
* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Any leave required under federal, state, or local law

Benefits are subject to vesting and eligibility requirements.

Applications are being accepted on an ongoing basis.

#LI-MH1

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
The role of the Plant Manager is to coordinate and direct production activity through the manufacturing processes while meeting company production, quality, safety and profitability goals. In addition, the Plant Manager will apply the principles of Lean Manufacturing to direct the workforce in promoting a continuous improvement atmosphere and culture.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES and TASKS**

* Coordinate production activities for hourly employees and related salaried staff insuring all manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a timely and cost effective manner.
* Control and minimize labor overtime.
* Maintain Production Schedules and Quality Standards
* Ensure effective utilization of MRP system throughout process
* Recognize and solve problems affecting production, quality, safety and productivity.
* Apply the tools of Lean Manufacturing .
* Minimize attrition through effective hiring and coaching practices.
* Foster a culture of empowerment so that all levels of employees are engaged in continuous improvement activities.
* Help implement and maintain preventative maintenance programs. Make recommendations for facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Incorporate shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.

* Provide direction, development and leadership to production employees through performance management tools.
* Provide effective communication to support the needs of the employees as well as the goals of the organization.
* Actively engage in all Safety initiatives to meet or exceed EH&S goals and plans.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS and EDUCATION**

* BSIE or BSME
* Minimum 8 years in manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures
* Minimum 5 years in supervisors/management position
* Strong background in MRP systems, preferably Microsoft AX that includes expertise with Material Bills, Routings and Work Standards.
* Proven success in large scale process improvement initiatives within manufacturing environment and cross functional teams
* Training in Lean Manufacturing, TPS, and Demand Flow
* Exceptional communication and proven leadership skills

**SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, LICENSES, CERTIFICATIONS, ETC:**

* Competent in Microsoft Office including Word, Excel and Outlook

### **PHYSICAL EFFORT**

* Ability to sit, stand, walk intermittently for 8 hours.
* Ability to work on a PC as required.

records.title: Senior Director of Operations
records.description:
The Senior Director of Operations oversees all aspects of operations and provides leadership to the plant managers across multiple sites in a campus environment. Overall responsibility for Production, Maintenance, Personnel Scheduling, and Safety, as well as associated responsibilities in Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Human Resources, Commercialization and other related areas. The Director of Operations is also responsible for establishing the campus culture, servicing business needs, and the 3-year masterplan that delivers all KPIs of Safety, Quality, Customer Service and Cost control.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and oversee ongoing performance and efficiency of all plant functions through the establishment and monitoring of KPI's that seek to meet and/or exceed corporate objectives.
* Develop and mentor plant teams, future leaders, and succession planning by partnering with plant managers and human resources.
* Responsible for strategy development based on customer support, OpEx, return on capital, transformational goals, increasing capacity and throughput and cost discipline.
* Formulates and implements manufacturing programs to maintain and improve the competitive position and profitability of the operations. Set structure and discipline in daily management and utilizing data and KPI's to drive priorities and decisions.
* Sets Fiscal Year and 90-day priorities for the plants.
* Rapidly communicate to Vice President of Operations any significant challenges or failures that may pose a risk to the business.
* Leads the development and implementation of TPM strategies that maximize operational effectiveness/performance while partnering with other divisions to develop actionable plans to improve overall operational effectiveness.

* Directly supervise a team of leaders who supervise leaders.

records.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

The Plant Manager directs overall plant operations and the retail store ensuring the achievement of production objectives at the lowest cost consistent with the company quality standards and customer delivery requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

1. Prioritize, schedule and delegate work assignments and directly supervise the plant staff to ensure the achievement of production objectives at the lowest cost consistent with company quality requirements.

2. Monitor suppliers to ensure that they efficiently and effectively provide needed goods or services within budgetary limits.

3. Direct or coordinate financial or budget activities to fund operations, maximize investments, or increase efficiency.

4. Evaluate, recommend, and implement improvements in methods and processes to increase productivity and quality.

5. Develop plans for the maximum utilization of materials, machines and employees.

6. Review production costs and product quality; modify production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of division.

7. Ensure proper maintenance of equipment and building and establish plant housekeeping standards.

8. Develop and recommend plant capital and operating budgets to ensure conformance to budgets.

9. Develop policies and procedures to ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental and various regulatory agencies.

10. Enforce safety and work rules and company housekeeping standards.

11. Recommend locations for new facilities or oversee the remodeling or renovating of current facilities.

12. Ensure compliance with all quality, SQF, HACCP, safety, and sanitation regulations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Manage supervisors who supervise employees in the manufacturing of company products. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

 **Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

Requires a bachelor's degree in production and operations management from a four-year college or university plus a minimum of five years progressively responsible related experience; or ten years progressively responsible related experience; or a combination of education and experience. Requires the ability to operate a computer and

standard office machines. Requires a general knowledge of company products and procedures. Requires a working knowledge of accounting methods and cost control procedures.

Language Skills

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret blueprints, customer specifications, general business periodicals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, customers, and other employees of the organization.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as algebraic formulas, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Wear required safety equipment when on shop floor. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand. The employee is occasionally required to walk; sit; and use hands to finger, handle, or touch objects, tools, or controls. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.

 **Additional Information**

*The hiring range for this role is $135,000 - $145,000 yearly**. Actual wages will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Jack Link’s Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Jack Link’s provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.*

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**: 
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**: 
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant / office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet / slippery floors. Travel may be required.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:** 
Jack Link’s provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic that is protected by federal, state or local law.

**E-VERIFY:** 
Jack Link’s is participant in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees. For information about the E-Verify program, please visit: http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify/employees

records.description:
**Why you will love working at Maola Local Dairies™**:

* Built on over a century of dedication, Maola is always looking ahead investing in our people, strengthening our communities, and securing fresh, local dairy for the future.
* Join a farmer-owned cooperative rooted in integrity, sustainability, and a passion for providing fresh, high-quality Maola dairy products.
* We prioritize your well-being with competitive pay, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, and more
* Our employees are an integral part of who we are — what you do and what you think matters.

**SUMMARY:**

The Plant Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for all manufacturing at Maola Local Dairies – Philadelphia. 
 
You will execute strategies to optimize safety, food quality, performance, equipment reliability, cost-effectiveness, and profitability. You will build a culture of operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement while developing a high-performing leadership team to drive sustainable results. This role requires a hands-on, results-oriented leader with extensive manufacturing experience, technical expertise in fluid milk processing and packaging, strong financial acumen, and proven success in a unionized facility. You must translate company goals into clear departmental priorities and ensure consistent execution across the entire plant.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**1. Operational Leadership & Manufacturing Performance**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily plant operations, ensuring production schedules, customer requirements, and business objectives are consistently achieved.
* Establish and maintain operational standards that drive improvements in production efficiency, OEE, throughput, yield, and order fulfillment.
* Demonstrate strong technical understanding of pasteurization, UHT processing, fluid milk manufacturing, and packaging operations.
* Drive equipment reliability and asset utilization through effective partnership with Maintenance and Engineering leadership.
* Establish disciplined management routines, performance reviews, and accountability systems to identify and eliminate operational losses.
* Ensure effective coordination between Production, Maintenance, Quality, Sanitation, Warehousing, and Scheduling.

**2. Financial & Business Management**

* Maintain full operational and financial accountability for plant performance, including operating budgets, labor costs, maintenance expenditures, material utilization, and manufacturing costs.
* Partner with department leaders to establish, manage, and maintain departmental budgets.
* Monitor plant financial performance against established budgets and proactively address unfavorable variances.
* Develop and execute cost-reduction strategies focused on eliminating waste, reducing overtime, improving labor productivity, and optimizing maintenance expenditures.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of plant P&L performance, cost per unit, conversion costs, and key manufacturing financial indicators.
* Ensure department heads understand their financial responsibilities and maintain ownership of their respective budgets.

**3. TPM & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the implementation and sustainment of TPM principles and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the facility.
* Establish a culture focused on identifying, understanding, and eliminating the root causes of operational losses.
* Drive improvements in equipment reliability, preventive maintenance execution, planned maintenance, and overall asset effectiveness.
* Challenge normalized deviance and reinforce adherence to established operating standards and best practices.
* Develop structured problem-solving capabilities throughout the leadership team and frontline organization.
* Establish meaningful performance indicators and management routines to measure progress, sustain improvements, and reinforce accountability.

**4. Safety, Food Safety & Quality**

* Establish and maintain an uncompromising commitment to employee safety, food safety, and product quality.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, company policies, food safety programs, and manufacturing standards.
* Partner with Quality and Sanitation leadership to prevent quality failures, reduce product holds, minimize waste, and protect customer confidence.
* Ensure incidents, deviations, and nonconformances receive appropriate investigation, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Promote proactive employee engagement and leadership participation in safety and quality initiatives.

**5. Leadership, Organizational Development & Labor Relations**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a capable and accountable management team.
* Establish clear performance expectations and ensure department leaders demonstrate ownership of their respective areas.
* Build organizational capability through leadership development, employee engagement, succession planning, and effective performance management.
* Demonstrate authentic, approachable, and visible leadership throughout all levels of the facility.
* Foster a positive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented environment that encourages initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate the ability to effectively lead and develop a unionized workforce through constructive labor relations, consistent application of collective bargaining agreements, and proactive employee engagement.
* Establish productive working relationships with union representatives and employees while balancing organizational objectives, workforce needs, and contractual obligations.
* Address employee relations matters with professionalism, consistency, fairness, and sound judgment.
* Promote a culture of mutual respect, accountability, and shared responsibility for operational performance.

**6. Customer & Executive Engagement**

* Effectively communicate plant performance, business challenges, operational priorities, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Represent the Philadelphia facility professionally in customer interactions, audits, and business reviews as needed.
* Ensure customer commitments, product quality expectations, and service requirements remain central to operational decision-making.
* Establish cross-functional partnerships that support broader organizational objectives and business growth.

**BASIC REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, preferably within the dairy, fluid milk, food, or beverage manufacturing industries required
* Minimum of 7 years of experience successfully leading a unionized manufacturing workforce, including labor relations, employee engagement, and collective bargaining agreement administration required.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience leading complex manufacturing operations with multiple production lines and supporting departments required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience with technical knowledge of pasteurization, fluid milk processing, and packaging equipment and systems required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience managing operating budgets, departmental expenditures, and plant P&L performance required.
* Minimum of 5 year of experience in improving manufacturing efficiency, equipment reliability, labor productivity, and cost performance required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience implementing TPM, Lean Manufacturing, or other continuous improvement methodologies required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience leading, developing, and holding department-level leadership teams accountable for measurable results required.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience understanding of food safety, quality systems, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety required.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Communication
* + *Communicate clearly and effectively through multiple channels – oral, written, visual, and non-verbal – ensuring our messages are understood and delivered appropriately, whether in-person or digitally.*
* Accountability
* + *Take responsibility for actions and anticipate challenges before they arise.*
 + *Solve problems both within and outside of departments, proactively addressing issues as they occur.*
* Customer Focused
* + *Prioritize understanding and meeting both internal and external customer needs.*
 + *Ensure high levels of satisfaction and loyalty by anticipating customer requirements and striving for exceptional service.*
* Initiative
* + *Proactive in identifying opportunities and addressing potential threats.*
 + *Act independently and decisively, rather than waiting for situations to demand action.*
* Problem-Solving
* + *Possess the ability to identify and address complex issues with minimal guidance.*
 + *Skilled at analyzing challenges and finding practical, effective solutions.*
* Collaboration
* + *Take responsibility for deliverables while also supporting others to ensure that collective goals are met.*
 + *Able to work harmoniously with others toward a common goal, recognizing and valuing each person’s contributions, is fundamental to successful collaboration.*

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand and walk. The employee must be able to reach, bend, extend, and lift 50-60 pounds.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* The work environment may require working in the cooler room with varying degrees of temperature and may include contact with water or dairy liquids.
* Exposed to a noise level of 90 decibels. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate/high. Wet/slippery work conditions.
