records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Job description:

Job Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Operations Manager to lead and optimize daily store operations, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers and a motivating environment for team members. This role requires a proactive leader with strong management skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for retail excellence. As an Operations Manager, you will oversee all aspects of store functions, from sales and customer service to inventory control and staff supervision, driving operational efficiency and sales growth.

Duties

* Lead and manage the retail team, including hiring, training, coaching, and developing staff to achieve high performance standards.
* Oversee daily store operations such as cash handling, POS system management, merchandising, stocking, and inventory control to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
* Implement effective sales strategies by managing pricing, promotions, and product placement to maximize revenue.
* Supervise shift management activities, including scheduling, task delegation, and ensuring excellent customer service at all times.
* Conduct employee orientation sessions, interviews for new hires, and ongoing training to foster a knowledgeable and motivated team.
* Manage purchasing decisions, vendor relations, and inventory replenishment to maintain optimal stock levels while controlling costs.
* Enforce safety protocols, manage payroll processing, bookkeeping tasks, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Utilize management skills to analyze sales data, prepare budgets, monitor expenses, and identify opportunities for operational improvements.

Experience

* Proven managerial experience in retail store management or a similar leadership role within the retail industry.
* Demonstrated success in supervising sales teams with a focus on retail sales management and customer service excellence.
* Strong background in inventory management, POS systems operation, merchandising, and cash handling procedures.
* Experience in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding new employees, and conducting training & development initiatives.
* Knowledge of retail math including pricing strategies, budgeting techniques, and basic financial analysis.
* Bilingual or multilingual skills are highly desirable to effectively communicate with diverse customer bases.
* Previous experience with grocery or wireless sales environments is a plus; familiarity with retail industry standards is essential.

Join us as an Operations Manager to lead with energy and purpose! Your leadership will inspire your team to deliver outstanding customer experiences while driving operational success. We value proactive problem-solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments — if you’re passionate about retail management and ready to make an impact, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $80,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

records.title: Operations Director - Healthcare
records.description:
**Operations Director**
=======================

**Lead the Team. Drive Growth. Make an Impact.**
------------------------------------------------

Aveanna Healthcare is seeking an experienced and motivated **Operations Director (OD)** to lead the overall operations, growth, and performance of one of our locations.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys developing teams, and knows how to balance **people, performance, growth, and operational excellence**.

As the Operations Director, you’ll serve as the leader of your branch, partnering closely with clinical, operational, recruiting, and business development teams to ensure we deliver exceptional care while meeting growth and financial goals.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead & Develop Your Team**

* Lead, coach, and support a high-performing branch team.
* Recruit and retain qualified staff.
* Establish goals, monitor performance, and complete timely performance evaluations.
* Promote employee development, accountability, and strong communication.
* Partner with area and regional leadership to keep branch priorities aligned with organizational goals.

### **Drive Branch Growth**

* Develop and implement strategies to grow the business and expand patient services.
* Maintain a strong sense of urgency around referrals, admissions, and start-of-care timelines.
* Partner with business development and referral sources to strengthen relationships and identify growth opportunities.
* Monitor the referral pipeline and address barriers that could delay patient care.

### **Build Strong Relationships**

* Develop trusted relationships with patients, families, caregivers, referral partners, and community partners.
* Support patient introductions and periodic home visits when needed.
* Follow up on satisfaction surveys and identify opportunities to improve the patient and caregiver experience.
* Serve as an advocate and trusted leader for your branch team.

### **Own Operational & Financial Performance**

* Monitor branch performance, staffing, productivity, revenue, billing, collections, and expenses.
* Review financial statements and operational reports to identify trends and opportunities.
* Identify ways to improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary costs, and strengthen branch performance.
* Oversee caregiver staffing and ensure service delivery expectations are consistently met.

### **Maintain Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure the branch operates in accordance with company policies, payor requirements, and applicable state and federal regulations.
* Partner with clinical leadership to address quality concerns and implement corrective actions when necessary.
* Monitor key performance indicators to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Promote a culture centered on accountability, compliance, service excellence, and quality patient care.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Associate degree or equivalent related work experience required.
* 2–3 years of management or leadership experience.
* Strong leadership and staff-development skills.
* Excellent communication, organization, and time-management abilities.
* Ability to make confident decisions and solve problems in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
* Ability to remain professional and composed in challenging situations.
* Must meet all applicable state requirements, including background checks and work authorization requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Healthcare leadership or operations experience.
* Pediatric or home healthcare experience.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------

* Ability to travel as needed.
* Ability to work in a variety of home and healthcare environments.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries at all times.
* Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand English.
* Must meet the physical requirements necessary to perform the essential functions of the position.

**Why This Role?**
------------------

The Operations Director is more than a branch management position. You’ll have the opportunity to **build a strong team, grow the business, strengthen community relationships, and directly influence the quality of care provided to patients and families.**

If you’re a results-driven leader who enjoys developing people, solving problems, and taking ownership of business performance, this could be the next step in your career.

**Vaccination Requirements**
----------------------------

As an employer accepting Medicare and Medicaid funds, employees must comply with applicable health-related requirements in relevant jurisdictions, including required vaccinations and testing, subject to appropriate medical or religious exemptions.

records.title: Director, Operations
records.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! 
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Does the thought of joining one of the fastest-growing, privately held data center companies sound exciting to you? Do you enjoy collaborating with team members to drive and operate some of the industry’s leading and most innovative infrastructure solutions?

At **Aligned Data Centers**, not only do we celebrate success across our platform, we celebrate the very teams that drive and support that success! Our culture is founded in passion, engineered from innovation, and driven by the pursuit of operational excellence. We are a company dedicated to driving positive change in the industry through continuous data center innovation, diversity and inclusion, and corporate sustainability.

We realize not only is providing a comprehensive benefits package important, but we also provide a generous 401k match with immediate vesting, free membership to Gympass which provides our employees a rich health and wellness benefit and competitive time off plan. Giving back and having fun is important to our team whether it be serving our communities or employee and customer events. ***Our Aligned DNA is what makes us unique and successful!***

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

The Director Operations is responsible for leading and executing all aspects of the campus operations to include safety, security, reliability, network environment, customer relations, the critical environment, and P&L. This role will strategize, manage, and operate multiple Datacenter facilities for Aligned. 
The Director of Operations will ensure all Datacenter facility systems meet or exceed industry standards for critical maintenance resulting in 100% uptime, ensures the building engineering and security teams follow all reporting and documentation processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and meets all customer service level agreements and compliance audits. The Director of Operations will serve as the liaison for all 24x7 operational activities across their managed facilities with executives and department heads to ensure appropriate communications with all interested and vested parties. They will lead and direct the staff in their market to optimize employee potential and maximize Aligned’s continued growth in existing and new markets. This role reports to the SVP of Operations or their designee.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provides senior leadership to drive strategic vision for Aligned’s datacenters, including Critical Facilities Operations, Preventative Maintenance, Commissioning, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Security, Logistics, and Safety on a Senior level.
* Manages Campus operations of the 24x7 Datacenter environment. Identifies and implements critical metrics necessary to manage and monitor the performance of overall operations including, but not limited to, capacity, availability, budget, and inventory. Oversees all electrical and mechanical infrastructure such as UPS systems, generators, fire suppression systems, BMS, and HVAC systems Has responsibility for meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Ensures that all work performed within the Datacenter is done to high quality and without impact to any internal/external customers.
* Oversees requirements and delivery of services provided by Operations, Security, and Safety. Drives maximum potential of these functions to provide exceptional services to clients and employees.
* Oversees and supports the level 5 commissioning, operations, and maintenance of all Datacenter mission critical infrastructure in order to achieve 100% availability. Manages Datacenter facility expansion and consolidation.
* Manages, coaches, and develops management team performing Datacenter operations.
* Manages and leads vendor relationship to maintain day to day operations and strategic goals for Datacenter Operations SLA’s and deliverables. Works with current vendor stakeholders and partners to develop and deliver strategic plans. Oversees all Datacenter vendor contracts, streamlining services required and optimizing overall costs.
* Will work closely with all strategic supply chain vendors to ensure Aligned’s lean management strategies and continuous innovation and process improvement are fully implemented.
* Evaluates and mitigates risk on new and existing programs within datacenter program governance.
* Develops opportunities for cross-team effectiveness and remove organizational barriers for strong teamwork, collaboration, and excellent service delivery.
* Drives Aligned’s Sustainability Strategy and creates a program to improve the efficiency of the Datacenter operations.
* Engages in improvement projects, which often requires reaching out to a variety of support teams and driving them from conception to completion.
* Manages budgeting and forecasting, planning, deployment, incident and problem management, change management.
* Maintains documentation and diagrams capturing all essential parameters of Datacenter operations.
* Defines policies, procedures, and standards related to performance, capacity, availability, continuity, and security.
* Creates and delivers presentations to leadership team, company meetings, and conferences.
* Will meet all customer service levels and power utilization efficiency commitments and take an active role in on-going customer interaction. Participate in customer service review discussion and various ad-hoc meetings related to Datacenter management issues.
* Manages customer service orders and remote hand requests.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors, and customers.
* Ensure compliance with all safety procedures as well as utilization of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Respond quickly and appropriately to emergency situations (i.e., fire, evacuation, equipment failure etc.) and any customer concerns.
* Ensures inventory control programs/purchase parts and supplies are maintained.
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes, requisitions, government agencies and AE directives as relates to building and critical environment operations.
* Operational Roles may also apply as necessary.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred with 10 years’ experience or minimum of 12-15 years of related experience in lieu of degree.

* Ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret complex project documents, AutoCAD, Visio, and PDF documents.
* Ability to project and time manage effectively.
* Ability to develop operational standards, project tracking, and management documents.
* Ability to effectively respond, verbally or written, to sensitive issues, complex inquiries, or complaints.
* Ability to make effective presentations and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the public.
* Requires a high level of commitment to customer service, whether co-workers or clients.
* Requires in-depth knowledge of all applicable rules, laws, codes, regulations, and ordinances in performing data/communications and MEP projects.
* Ability to estimate cost of client installations and other assigned projects. Cost tracking for all projects.
* Knowledge of Purchase Order Requests process and invoice tracking.
* Develops appropriate RFP processes in addition to development of operating and capital budgets.
* Ability to analyze and solve problems involving several options with limited information.
* Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form and to work independently.
* Demonstrate ability to work well under pressure with a proactive approach to unusual occurrences.
* Requires good organizational skills, attention to detail and an openness to new ideas and procedures.
* MSOffice applications. i.e., Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Occasional travel will be required for training and meetings.

**BENEFITS & PERKS:**

Aligned Data Centers is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our team members. Eligible employees have access to:

* **Health Coverage**: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* **Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts:** HSA with employer contribution for eligible participants. FSA's offered for health and dependent care to increase tax savings.
* **Retirement Savings**: 401(k) plan with company match
* **Paid Time Off and Holiday Pay**
* **Company-Sponsored Insurance**: Short-Term Disability, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability (with medical election)
* **Optional Benefits**: Voluntary life, critical illness, legal, and additional disability coverage
* **Wellness Programs**: Employee assistance program (EAP), Wellhub gym membership, and other wellness initiatives

*The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.*

*At Aligned, we are committed to transparency and fostering a positive employee experience from your very first interaction with us. In compliance with Illinois pay disclosure requirements, when you join Aligned, you’ll have access to the following benefits: medical, dental, vision, short and long disability, life insurance and other voluntary benefits, 401k with employer match, bonus opportunities, paid time off, wellness benefits and professional development opportunities, all designed to support your well-being and career growth. We want you to have a clear understanding of what we offer, so you can make informed decisions about your future with us.*

*Aligned is equally committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities for all employees. We ensure that all applicants and team members are considered for employment, advancement, and all other employment-related matters without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

*If you require a reasonable accommodation to perform the essential functions of your job due to a disability or medical condition, please contact our People & Culture team. Accommodation requests will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis in accordance with applicable laws. Aligned will make reasonable accommodations where necessary to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their role.*

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Advanced Drainage Systems is a leading manufacturer of stormwater and onsite septic wastewater solutions, committed to sustainability and innovation. With a vast manufacturing and distribution network, we deliver high-quality products across multiple industries while recycling over half a billion pounds of plastic annually. At ADS, we foster a culture where diverse perspectives drive better ideas, ensuring every employee feels valued, heard, and empowered to make an impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are looking for a Plant Manager to join our team! In this role, you will oversee plant operations, ensuring safety, driving production, and collaborating with various departments to achieve business objectives. If you are passionate about manufacturing operations, we would love to hear from you!
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Champion a safe work environment by leading initiatives that embed a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with all regulatory, environmental, and corporate standards.
* Drive plant performance across safety, quality, productivity, cost, delivery, and employee retention metrics.
* Lead and sustain continuous improvement efforts using Lean principles and data-driven problem-solving to eliminate waste and improve operational efficiency.
* Promote a culture of discipline, consistency, and accountability by reinforcing standardized processes and work practices.
* Manage staffing levels, succession planning, and talent development to align with production needs and build leadership capability across all shifts.
* Coach, mentor, and engage frontline leaders to strengthen decision-making and team performance.
* Support company’s culture statement by fostering employee engagement strategies to reduce turnover, improve morale, and sustain productivity.
* Translate corporate and regional strategies into actionable plant-level objectives, leveraging technology, data, and CI tools to achieve sustained KPI improvements safely.
* Oversee inventory control, materials management, and fulfillment accuracy to support production goals and superior customer service.
* Develop, manage, and adjust the operational budget in response to changing business demands and market conditions.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships with EHS, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance, and Quality teams to align operational plans, schedules, and priorities.
* Communicate plant performance clearly and consistently to employees, peers, and leadership to ensure transparency and shared accountability.
* Participate in regional initiatives and enterprise projects that support manufacturing excellence and align plant objectives with broader corporate priorities.
* Engage with local organizations, schools, and events to build meaningful community relationships that enhance ADS brand visibility and position the plant as a preferred local employer.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or significant manufacturing and management experience.
* 10+ years of managerial experience in a production environment.
* Proven leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Strong operational skills and knowledge of lean business practices.
* Ability to drive results in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to work as a team leader/member with diverse groups.
* Regularly required to sit, stand, reach, bend, and move about the facility.
* Occasionally lift and move up to 25 lbs.
* Travel – 10%.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Operational and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of lean business practices.
* Ability to coach and develop team members.
* Strong communication skills.

Compensation Range: $110,000 - $140,000
  
  
Individual pay may vary and is determined by work location, shift, and factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. ADS offers competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, and competitive medical and retirement benefit programs. Your recruiter can share more specific information on the role and location of which you apply.
  
  
**Company Benefits**
**Health & Welfare Benefits:**
Medical and prescription drug plans, telemedicine (with medical plan), High-Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) and Health Savings Account (HSA), dental and vision plans, virtual physical therapy\*, an employee assistance program (EAP)\*, and voluntary accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnification programs.
  
  
**Financial Benefits:**
Retirement 401k program with company match, an employee stock purchase plan (voluntary), financial wellness planning\*, paid parental leave\*, flexible spending accounts (FSA) for child care and health care, short-term and long-term disability\*, basic life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D)\*, adoption financial reimbursement\*, tuition reimbursement\*, voluntary life insurance (for employees, spouses, and children), and voluntary identity theft and fraud protection.
  
  

* 100% paid by ADS.

**Why Join ADS?**
**Growth Opportunities & Global Presence:**
With a global network of approximately 70 manufacturing plants and 40 distribution centers, ADS offers extensive opportunities for career growth and development in various locations around the world.
  
  
**Inclusive and Creative Work Culture:**
ADS fosters a culture of passion, innovation, and continuous improvement, empowering employees to shape industry-leading solutions. We value diverse perspectives, recognizing that they drive better ideas, processes, and performance. Our workplace is built on respect, inclusivity, and shared responsibility, ensuring every team member feels valued and contributes to our collective success.
  
  
**Innovative & Sustainability Focused:**
Advanced Drainage Systems is one of the largest plastic recyclers in North America, ensuring over half a billion pounds of plastic is kept out of landfills every year.
  
  
**Learn More:**
https://www.adspipe.com/about-us
  
  
**EEO Statement**
ADS supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience, and background. We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. ADS is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
The Signal Hill power plant is strategically located in Wichita County, Texas, near the rapidly expanding Dallas/Fort Worth metropolitan area. This 77 MW electric power generation facility utilizes GE gas combustion turbines, along with associated heat recovery steam generators and an ABB steam generator. Signal Hill plays a critical role in supplying power to the ERCOT market during periods of peak demand and supply volatility. The facility was honored with the 2014 Certificate of Recognition by the City of Wichita Falls, Texas, for its outstanding achievements in environmental excellence, including pollution prevention, waste minimization, and water conservation.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Plant Manager to oversee the operations of the Signal Hill power plant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power plant management and a commitment to operational excellence, safety, and environmental stewardship. As Plant Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring the efficient and reliable operation of the facility, while maintaining compliance with all regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

This is an opportunity for a hands-on leader who wants to do more than maintain the status quo. You’ll step into an established operation with a strong foundation and a clear opportunity to shape what comes next.
  
  
We’re looking for a leader who can quickly assess the operation, identify opportunities, strengthen and develop the team, establish clear priorities, and move with urgency from strategy to execution. You’ll have the opportunity to tackle meaningful operational challenges, accelerate improvements, and see the results of your leadership firsthand.

* Build, develop, and motivate a high-performing leadership team.

**What We're Looking For...**
  
  

* Our ideal candidate brings:

+ Proven plant leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
+ Demonstrated success improving or turning around manufacturing operations.
+ Strong knowledge of predictive and preventive maintenance and how to effectively implement maintenance programs.
+ Strong business acumen with an understanding of financial performance and P&L.
+ The ability to assess an operation quickly, identify gaps, and turn priorities into an actionable plan.
+ A track record of developing and leading high-performing teams.
+ Strong communication and motivational leadership skills.

+ A leadership style that combines urgency, accountability, integrity, and respect for people.

* Exposure to extreme heat, loud noise, dirt, dust, odors, and fumes is probable
* Required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) in required areas

**Preferred**

* Paper converting, chemical or plastics processing, or packaging industrial experience
* Lean manufacturing experience

Dart makes everyday products that give people the freedom to enjoy the food & drinks they love, wherever they are. * Direct the development and submission of required reports to assure documentation and communication of plant operations, maintenance, and environmental activities.

This position also requires finger dexterity, good vision/hearing, hand coordination, and the ability to perform close work, analyze data/reports, conduct research, and implement recommendations. records.description:
Select Milk Producers is one of the nation’s largest and most progressive dairy cooperatives, with 32 wholly owned subsidiaries, 8 processing plants, and 8 joint ventures including Continental Dairy Facilities, Continental Dairy Facilities Southwest, Mill Haven Foods, Select Custom Solutions, GreenLink and Select Services. With over 800 employees, the Select Milk family of companies impacts all aspects of the dairy farm business and at the heart of our family of companies, is you.
  
  
"We strive to go above and beyond what’s expected in providing for our families, leading our employees, caring for our land and animals, serving our customers, producing quality milk, and serving one another. This commitment is more than our business, it’s in our culture and our character. We believe in being accountable, in doing what’s right, in performing at our best, in setting a higher standard."
  
  
Select Milk Producers and its subsidiaries offer an attractive compensation and a best-in-class benefits package that includes but is not limited medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more that can be tailored for you and your family. Other benefits for eligible employees include 401(k) up to 6% company match, life and disability insurance, and paid holidays & vacation. We are proud to promote an equal employment opportunity workplace.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Plant Operations: Review daily inventories and plan daily production. Conduct daily staff meetings to coordinate daily plant activities. Review daily load out schedule and coordinate with staff and milk movement personnel. Review daily production efficiencies and production reports. Review companies KPI’s, plant loss and assist in setting goals. Reports directly to the Director of Operations.
* Plant Quality: Review microbiology test results daily and direct further investigation of high counts. Review list of any out-of-spec. product with Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Manager. Review all product C of A's.
* Plant Audits: Check each department daily. Check employee GMP’s. Review daily report of audits. Assist Quality Assurance with all plant audits.
* Industrial Wastewater: Check wastewater facility daily. Review daily reports as required.
* Sanitation: Review CIP records daily. Review random equipment checks with chemical account representative.
* Plant Employees: Audit sampling techniques and sanitation practices. Monitor production departments throughout shift and assure employee compliance with GMP’s, sanitation and safety. Provide training as needed. Provide annual GMP and HACCP training.
* Purchasing: Review and approve order supplies. Track purchases and prepare appropriate paperwork.
* Equipment: Verify that all plant equipment is in good working condition and all preventative maintenance is being performed on a scheduled basis. Review and approve all work orders. Review all daily maintenance activity reports. Develop capital justifications to update equipment as needed.
* Environmental: Review of Air Quality annual reports. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Form R for EPA/Health Department. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Hazardous Materials Inventory and Business Plan. Perform other duties, as necessary.
* Safety: Review Safety program and training with EHS management. Daily observation during plant audit will include safety. Check each department and observe employee safety procedures. Member of the Food Safety Team and Food Quality Team.
* Leadership: Utilize Code of Conduct and core values to drive development and growth opportunities for all team members.
* Support a company culture of continuous improvement by participating in efficiency and improvement efforts.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* This position has management and employee supervisory responsibilities for the entire facility in the area of discipline, hiring, and firing.
* Review on the job training reviews.
* Coordinate on the job training.
* Oversee adherence to company policies and procedures.
* Oversee scheduling of management, employees, and temporary labor.
* Have the responsibility of reviewing timesheets, overtime and approve payroll.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**

* An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Must have the ability to trouble shoot problems and be persistent until a solution is found.
* Must work in a safe manner and follow all safety procedures including use of safety equipment.
* Must be willing to ask for assistance when the process is unclear.
* Proficient in verbal and written communication skills. Must be able to communicate with upper management on a daily basis.
* Leadership, team development, coaching, and / or teaching experience.
* Good math and statistical skills.
* Excellent computer skills for data input, report writing, program tracking.
* Excellent organizational and follow through skills.

**Education And/Or Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Dairy or Food Science and four years of experience in a Plant leadership role in a Dairy or Food Manufacturing facility is strongly desired.

About the company

We're an EV commercial vehicle manufacturer based in Orange County, California. We design and build our medium-duty electric vehicles in-house, and next year's production is already fully sold out.

* A 2,000-vehicle order from one of the largest US parcel carriers, due by end of 2027

**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to grow our production capacity and own how we get there.

You'll lead the team that designs, buys and launches our new lines and equipment. Your decisions will show up directly in how many trucks leave the factory each month.

What you'll do

* Lead and grow the advanced manufacturing engineering team

* Take new lines and equipment from concept through design, build, install, testing and start of production

* Run equipment and facility projects to budget and schedule, and present them to the executive team
* Work closely with vehicle engineering, supply chain and operations so new designs can be built at volume
* Bring in integrators and equipment suppliers, and manage them through delivery

What you'll bring

**Must have**

* 8+ years in manufacturing engineering, with 4+ years leading teams
* A track record of growing production capacity: new lines, factory expansions or ramping to full rate
* Hands-on experience taking equipment from specification through install, testing and launch
* Experience building and managing capital budgets
* A degree in engineering (mechanical, manufacturing, industrial, chemical or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in EV, automotive, commercial vehicles or batteries. High-volume aerospace, heavy equipment or other complex hardware also welcome.
* Start-up or scale-up experience, ideally through early production and ramp-up
* Experience building a new factory from the ground up

records.title: Director Advanced Shipbuilding and Manufacturing Excellence
records.description:
**Job Summary**
The Director, Advanced Shipbuilding & Manufacturing Excellence is Gulf Copper's industrial design authority and the leader of its continuous improvement program. The Director owns the production-system concept for each Gulf Copper site in Galveston, Port Arthur, and Corpus Christi, Texas: how work flows through the yard, how material moves, what equipment and tooling are used, and how the facility is laid out to support it. On the front end, the Director defines the production-system, equipment, and layout requirements that the architect/engineering firm and construction manager design to, and leads the selection of production equipment and tooling. On an ongoing basis, the Director leads the company's effort to continuously improve shipbuilding, ship repair, and module fabrication methods, tooling, work content, and productivity across all sites, and investigates and introduces proven advanced manufacturing technologies including automation, robotics, digital shipbuilding, and artificial intelligence (AI). The role supports Gulf Copper's growth into construction of U.S. Navy (USN) and U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) vessels, government and commercial ship repair, and distributed fabrication of ship and submarine modules.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

This position is responsible for the following: Other duties may be assigned.

**Production-System Design Authority (Front End)**

* Own the production-system concept for each site, including process flow, material flow, shop and work-station arrangement, build strategy, and facility layout, and hold design authority over these elements within the facility modernization master plan.
* Define and approve the production-system, throughput, equipment, and layout requirements that the architect/engineering firm and construction manager design to, and review their deliverables for conformance to those requirements.
* Lead the specification, evaluation, and selection of production equipment and tooling, including heavy lift and cranes, panel and block assembly lines, cutting and welding systems, blast and paint facilities, material handling, and ship transfer and launch systems, including trade studies, vendor evaluation, and total-cost-of-ownership analysis.
* Define the role and target capacity of each facility (newbuild, repair, module fabrication, outfitting, and support) and the production-system requirements needed to achieve them, as input to capital sequencing decisions.
* Translate target vessel classes and customer requirements into facility and process requirements, including ship size, displacement, launch and transfer method, assembly sequence, test and trials, and delivery.
* Work with finance, business development, and the Grants and Workforce Development managers to develop business cases and cost models for production-system and equipment investments.

**Continuous Improvement & Industrial Engineering**

* Lead Gulf Copper's continuous improvement program across all sites, establishing the methodology, governance, cadence, and reporting for improvement of shipbuilding, ship repair, and module fabrication processes.
* Establish and maintain productivity baselines and targets (such as man-hours per ton, cycle time, first-pass yield, rework, and schedule adherence) by site, product line, and process, and report progress against them.
* Lead value-stream mapping, work measurement, line balancing, and takt-based planning for fabrication, assembly, outfitting, and repair processes.
* Develop, document, and sustain standard work, production standards, procedures, and work instructions that reflect current best methods, tooling, and facilities.
* Lead cross-functional improvement events and projects with yard operations, engineering, planning, quality, and supply chain, and track resulting savings against investment.
* Operate a lessons-learned loop that feeds production experience back into layout, equipment, tooling, and build-strategy decisions.
* Set methods, standards, and tooling for the yards; General Managers retain ownership of daily production execution.

**Advanced Technology: Automation, Robotics, Digital Shipbuilding & AI**

* Investigate, evaluate, and benchmark new shipbuilding technologies and methods through industry research, domestic and international shipyard visits, vendor engagement, and partnerships with government and academic organizations.
* Develop business cases, pilot programs, and implementation plans for new technologies, and lead implementation of proven techniques such as robotic and automated welding, cutting, and panel and module production lines.
* Evaluate and pilot AI, data analytics, and digital shipbuilding tools for production planning, scheduling, quality, and productivity improvement, and scale those that demonstrate value.
* Work with engineering, IT, and operations to integrate new technologies with design, production control, and quality systems.
* Partner with the Workforce Development Manager to train and upskill the workforce to operate and maintain new methods and technologies.

**Module Fabrication & Distributed Manufacturing**

* Define the production-system and facility requirements for complex module fabrication, including large steel, piping, outfitting, and system modules for surface ships and submarines.
* Establish standard processes for module design interfaces, tolerances, dimensional control, quality assurance, transportation, and integration across Gulf Copper sites and outside partners.
* Define the production approach and facility requirements for a distributed manufacturing model in which modules are built across Gulf Copper's Texas facilities and with partners, then transported and integrated at the final assembly site.

**Leadership, Collaboration & Reporting**

* Lead the industrial engineering and continuous improvement staff and matrixed engineering, planning, and project personnel assigned to advanced shipbuilding initiatives.
* Coordinate with yard General Managers, engineering, estimating, supply chain, quality, and safety to implement new methods, tooling, and equipment and to prepare the yards for new shipbuilding and repair work.
* Provide facility, capacity, production-approach, and productivity input to business development, capture, and proposal teams for USN, USCG, and commercial opportunities, and serve as technical subject-matter expert on production capability in customer and partner discussions.
* Prepare reports and presentations for executive leadership on production-system design status, equipment selection, continuous improvement results, technology initiatives, and facility readiness.
* Establish metrics and systems for tracking production-system milestones, equipment procurement, productivity, and capacity.

**Safety & Quality**

* Ensure new facilities, equipment, tooling, and methods are designed for safety and comply with applicable environmental, safety, and permitting requirements.
* Design processes and quality systems to meet NAVSEA, USCG, and classification society standards applicable to shipbuilding and ship repair, working with the Quality organization.
* Promote a strong safety culture in the introduction of new methods and technologies.

**Key Measures of Success:**

* Production-system concept, layout requirements, and equipment list approved for each site by the dates set in the facility modernization master plan.
* Productivity baselines established for each site and product line within the first year, with annual improvement targets set and met thereafter.
* Documented continuous improvement savings tracked against capital and program investment.
* Pilot-to-adoption rate and realized benefit of new technologies introduced.
* Standard work and production standards in place and maintained for modernized processes.

**Required Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial/Manufacturing Engineering, Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Management, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in shipbuilding or heavy industrial manufacturing, including at least 7 years in shipbuilding, ship repair, or marine module fabrication.
* Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, or industrial engineering programs in a production environment with measurable productivity results.
* Demonstrated experience defining production-system, equipment, or facility layout requirements for shipyard or heavy industrial facility modernization or expansion.
* Strong knowledge of modern shipbuilding production methods, including modular and zone construction, panel and block assembly, outfitting, and ship assembly and launch.
* Experience evaluating and implementing automation, robotics, or other advanced manufacturing technologies in a production environment.
* Knowledge of NAVSEA, USCG, and classification society standards applicable to shipbuilding and ship repair.
* Strong project management, budgeting, and scheduling skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with project scheduling and shipbuilding design and production software preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent continuous improvement certification.
* Experience with first-of-class production-system design for a greenfield or major brownfield shipyard stand-up, including panel line or block assembly line design.
* Experience constructing large, complex USN or USCG vessels such as icebreakers, combatants, or auxiliaries.
* Experience with distributed manufacturing of ship or submarine modules, including submarine industrial base programs.
* Experience benchmarking production methods at domestic and international shipyards.
* Experience with AI, digital shipbuilding, digital twin, or data-driven production planning tools.
* Experience with construction management or general contractor delivery models for large industrial facility projects.
* Prior senior leadership experience in shipyard operations, engineering, or production.

**Working Conditions:**

* Remote position.
* Regular travel among Gulf Copper's Galveston, Port Arthur, and Corpus Christi facilities, and to customer, supplier, partner, and industry sites, including international shipyard benchmarking.
* May require extended hours to meet project, customer, and production milestones.

**Necessary Equipment Operation:**

* Computer skills: MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and project scheduling software.
* Ability to review and use engineering, CAD, and 3D model information.
* Office equipment, including telephone, scanner, computer printer, etc.
* Personal protective equipment (PPE) required when working in shipyard areas.

**Special Skills:**

* Ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and drive sustained process improvement across multiple sites.
* Ability to evaluate and champion new methods and technologies and drive organizational change.
* Ability to think strategically over a 3–10 year horizon while delivering near-term improvement results.
* Ability to have difficult conversations with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to motivate employees and build a high-performing team.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and schedule pressures.
* Commitment to company values, policies, procedures, and safety programs.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Know Your Rights. If you’d like to view a copy of the company’s affirmative action plan or policy statement, please email: hrcorp@gulfcopper.com.  If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail: hrcorp@gulfcopper.com.

records.title: Senior Manager, Additive Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.
  
  
Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.
  
  
Purpose
  
  
We are seeking an exceptional, results-driven
**Senior Manager of Additive Manufacturing Operations**
to lead and scale our Factory 1 production organization. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for driving world-class execution across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people development while shaping the future of manufacturing.
  
  
The Additive Manufacturing organization leverages proprietary, state-of-the-art systems and processes to execute metal laser powder bed fusion (LPBF), depowdering, manual and automated support removal, surface finishing, heat treatment, and inspection across multiple factory sites supporting both prototype and high-rate production.
  
  
This role is ideal for an ambitious operations leader who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and combines strong manufacturing fundamentals with data-driven decision making, automation, and continuous improvement. Beyond delivering daily operational performance, this leader will develop people, build scalable operating systems, and partner with engineering to industrialize new technologies that will define the next generation of manufacturing.
  
  
The ideal candidate is energized by difficult manufacturing challenges, inspires high-performing teams, and is passionate about building organizations capable of delivering exceptional results.
  
  
The Role
  
  
**Operational Leadership**

* Lead Factory 1 additive manufacturing operations to achieve world-class performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and equipment reliability.
* Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing team while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
* Drive disciplined daily management through standard work, visual management, structured problem solving, and operational rigor.
* Optimize manufacturing flow by increasing equipment uptime, eliminating bottlenecks, improving process repeatability, and maximizing production throughput.
* Partner closely with Platform Development, Manufacturing Engineering, and Automation teams to successfully launch new equipment, technologies, and manufacturing capabilities.

**Operational Excellence**

* Champion Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement across all additive manufacturing processes.
* Establish scalable operating systems that improve efficiency, stability, and manufacturing readiness as production grows.
* Utilize manufacturing data, KPIs, and analytics to drive operational decisions and prioritize improvement initiatives.
* Develop meaningful performance dashboards and operating rhythms that enable rapid identification and resolution of production issues.
* Lead initiatives to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), first-pass yield, cycle time, labor productivity, and cost per part.

**Equipment Reliability & Technical Capability**

* Continue developing the in-house Additive Manufacturing Service organization by strengthening technical capability, preventive maintenance programs, troubleshooting processes, and technician training.
* Drive reliability initiatives that maximize printer availability, reduce unplanned downtime, and improve long-term equipment performance.
* Partner with technical teams to identify recurring equipment issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.

**Performance Monitoring & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), work instructions, process controls, and quality standards.
* Monitor key operational metrics and hold teams accountable for achieving business objectives.
* Drive disciplined root cause analysis and corrective actions to eliminate recurring manufacturing issues.
* Develop clear, actionable operational reporting that enables data-driven decision making across the organization.

**Safety, Quality & Financial Management**

* Foster a safety-first culture aligned with Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) standards and best practices.
* Partner with EHS to proactively develop and implement safety initiatives that reduce operational risk.
* Ensure manufacturing processes consistently meet internal quality requirements and applicable industry standards.
* Develop, manage, and execute the Factory 1 Additive Manufacturing operating budget while balancing productivity, cost, and long-term capability investments.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls.
* Demonstrated success leading complex manufacturing operations in high-performance production environments.
* Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing technical organizations.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing, operational excellence, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience using manufacturing data and operational metrics to drive strategic decision making and measurable business results.
* Proven ability to execute in startup or rapidly scaling manufacturing environments while effectively navigating ambiguity and change.
* Demonstrated success improving operational performance through equipment reliability, process optimization, and organizational development.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Weld Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Leadership experience in metal additive manufacturing or other advanced manufacturing environments.
* Experience with Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) production systems.
* Experience with aerospace manufacturing standards, including AS9100 and NADCAP.
* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Theory of Constraints, or similar operational excellence methodologies.
* Experience leading automation, Industry 4.0, MES, or digital manufacturing initiatives.
* Demonstrated success scaling manufacturing organizations through periods of rapid growth.

Pay Range: $156,640 USD - $215,380 USD
  
  
**What We Offer Our Regular, Full-Time Employees:**

* Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
* Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.

records.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!
  
  
In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by
*TIME*
as a “Best Invention”,
*MIT Technology Review*
as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and
*Fast Company*
as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.
  
  
Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.
  
  
**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**
Role Description
  
  
As the Senior Manager of Assembly Manufacturing Engineering, you will serve as the primary architect of the production lifecycle, bridging the gap between research prototypes and high-volume factory operations. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers to develop and internalize robust manufacturing processes for both battery enclosures and module/pack assembly—including robotic joining, sealing, electrolyte filling, and leak testing. By owning the full equipment lifecycle, from defining detailed user requirements through to factory testing and final site commissioning, you ensure that production lines are world-class, delivering a "machine that builds the machine" with precision and technical rigor.
  
  
Strategically, your objective is to drive operational scale by ensuring products are designed specifically for ease of manufacturing and assembly during the earliest development phases. You will champion a data-driven culture that utilizes failure mode analysis and advanced root-cause investigation to reduce production risks and achieve aggressive targets for quality, output rate, and equipment uptime. By fostering collaboration between Product Design, Quality, and Supply Chain, you will manage the critical transition from initial design to full-scale production, ensuring that every process is statistically validated to guarantee long-term reliability and cost-effectiveness.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead the development and optimization of battery manufacturing processes for battery assembly manufacturing.
* Ensure highly capable processes are identified and demonstrated for our production facilities ahead of detailed equipment design.
* Oversee the design and implementation of manufacturing processes such as: manual and robotic assembly, joining, sealing, system leak testing, and quality checks to achieve optimal performance and reliability.
* Collaborate with product design team, R&D, quality, and supply chain, to translate product requirements into a battery design and manufacturing process that achieve our company targets.
* Collaborate cross functionally to develop and maintain PFMEA, process specifications, measurement systems GR&R, control plan, and quality inspection methods (incoming, outgoing, and in-process).
* Lead troubleshooting efforts to identify root causes of manufacturing issues and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Internalize responsibility for delivery of equipment and processes that enable the operations team to achieve factory production metrics (quality, yield, rate, and availability).
* Identify trends/correlations, and make data-driven decisions for process optimization.

**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience in a high-volume manufacturing organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering.
* 10 years of experience in engineering roles within battery manufacturing or a related industry, with expertise in complex assembly processes. 4+ leading technical teams.
* Demonstrated experience in manufacturing equipment procurement, setup, and commissioning, including a clear understanding of equipment qualification and validation protocols.
* Strong understanding of lean manufacturing principles and their application in a high-volume production environment.
* Proven track record of successfully leading cross-functional teams in the development and optimization of manufacturing processes for electrochemical systems.
* Proficiency in process engineering principles, statistical analysis, and quality management systems for process optimization and improvement.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Leadership and mentoring abilities with a commitment to fostering a culture of continuous learning and accelerated innovation through quick iteration.
* Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment is a plus.

*This opportunity is based out of Form Factory 1 – Form Energy’s 550,000-square-foot, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility located in Weirton, WV, a commutable distance from Pittsburgh. Purpose-built for high-volume, advanced battery production, Form Factory 1 is a hub of fast-moving, collaborative work driving a new era of large-scale American energy manufacturing in the heart of the Rust Belt.*
*Relocation assistance is available.*
*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*
*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*
*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*
*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will
**never**
solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

records.description:
**Job Description**
As an S&C Electric team member, you’ll work on projects that have real-world impact. You’ll help transform the grid for resilient and reliable power worldwide. S&C has more than a 100-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee-owned since 2012. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively. Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner.
  
  
**Hours**

* 8:00 am – 5:00 pm (Mon-Fri) On Site Palatine, IL

**Compensation**
At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices.
**The estimated annual base salary range for this position is $154,968- $205,332.60.**
Individual pay within this salary range is determined by several compensable factors, including performance, knowledge, job-related skills and experience, and relevant education or training. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual incentive plan (AIP), subject to eligibility criteria.
  
  
**Join Our Team as a Senior Manager – Productions Operations!**
The Senior Manager – Production Operations is responsible for planning, overseeing, and managing the operations and production processes for the department, leading a team of Managers, Assistant Managers, and Supervisors to achieve strategic Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in safety, quality, delivery, and cost (SQDC). The Senior Manager – Production Operations focuses on strategic and tactical operations planning with a mid-term focus, contributing towards greater functional strategies, directing the smooth operations of multiple departments, driving strategic problem-solving and continuous improvement initiatives, reporting out to executive leadership on results, and making strategic adjustments and countermeasures when targets are missed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Health & Safety Compliance: Drive a safety-first culture, ensuring leaders understand and enforce safety rules. Ensure that health & safety is considered in all departmental plans in order to maintain and promote a safety-conscious manufacturing environment and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to production operations.
* Leadership & People Management: Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team. Role model appropriate and professional workplace behaviors, address/mediate conflicts to restore harmony, and support a positive, healthy, and inclusive workplace culture in accordance with S&C's mission, vision, values, and guiding principles. Manage departmental administrative team member processes, including but not limited to recruitment, induction, vacation management, performance reviews, performance improvement plans, and workforce/succession planning. Proactively establish, monitor, and hold team members accountable to clear responsibilities and accountabilities; provide ongoing performance feedback, both positive and developmental; address performance gaps in a timely manner; recognize and reward achievements and initiate decisions for corrective actions and terminations where required. Foster a culture that supports the growth and development of team members and proactively train, mentor, and coach team members.
* Strategy Implementation: Cascade strategies to develop mid-term tactical and operational plans for the function, in line with the company’s overall business objectives, including automation, insourcing, and unattended machining. Oversee a leadership team that directs the day-to-day operations of activities within the department and span of control, ensuring the timely and cost-effective delivery of outputs to KPIs. Work with senior leaders to recommend and implement strategic adjustments to operational plans in order to meet OKRs and KPIs.
* Production Planning & Operations: Lead strategic production planning initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop a mid-term plan for the department and initiate strategies that contribute to long-term production planning. Work with leaders to optimize production schedules, identify bottlenecks, and determine capacity plans and processing methods. Evaluate machine resources to ensure continued production and minimal downtime. Establish a balance between increased productivity and reduced costs of manufacturing operations. Set mid-term productivity goals and analyze report-outs from Managers.
* Lean Performance Systems: Recommend and implement goals for departmental performance improvement, supporting leaders as they identify and implement process improvements to enhance production efficiency, reduce costs, and increase overall operational effectiveness. Collaborate with other leaders to formulate high-level solutions and develop plans for how to implement improvements throughout multi-faceted functions. Serve as a change agent by influencing, communicating, and institutionalizing a culture of continuous improvement, simplification, standard work, process improvement, and lean principles.
* Quality Management: Oversee the implementation of broad quality control programs, ensuring leaders fully understand quality issues and their corresponding solutions.Discuss and understand high-level, multi-faceted quality issues and help leaders formulate resolutions. Monitor and guide leaders responsible for the department’s communication of corrective action plans, resolutions, and quality results.
* Reporting: Analyzes reports and reviews provided by first-line supervisors. Communicates regularly with upper management regarding problems impacting production. Reports issues regarding production, quality, maintenance, or personnel to senior and executive leadership.
* Budget Management: Develop and manage the function’s budget, ensuring accuracy and appropriate allocation of resources to maximize ROI and the achievement of larger functional strategies and objectives. Approve expenditures for the achievement of operational goals and work with senior leaders to identify investment opportunities for gains towards mid-term goals.
* Compliance: Understand and comply with all applicable Company policies and rules.
* Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
* Attend in-person or virtual meetings as requested or required.
* Communicate effectively and respectfully with others.
* Drive a car or other vehicle.
* Other responsibilities as assigned.

**Required**
**What you’ll need to succeed:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline such as Engineering, or a related field.
* Beliefs in, and alignment with, S&C Guiding Principles and Core Values
* 10+ years of manufacturing experience in an industrial metals fabrication environment, including advanced CNC machining, welding, laser cutting, forming, punching, stamping and related finishing operations.
* 5+ years of supervisory or management experience in a fabrication environment leading hourly and salaried employees.
* Leadership experience in workforce planning, scheduling, and staffing, employee development, coaching, and performance management.Experience managing multiple shifts is preferred.
* Knowledge of precision machining processes and practices within a high mix, low-to-medium volume environment.
* Demonstrated track record of lean manufacturing leadership, sustained improvements, and KPI attainment.
* Great leadership skills within a multi-level manufacturing environment, with an ability to lead, guide, motivate, and delegate to deliver results.
* Sound critical thinking, organizational, planning, and project management skills, and creative problem-solving when obstacles arise.
* Great interpersonal skills to establish meaningful relationships built on mutual trust and respect, navigate and resolve conflict, moderate behaviors, and foster collaborative working relationships amongst a diverse audience.
* Excellent communication skills, (written, verbal, listening, and presentation) ability to liaise with internal and external stakeholders at all levels, from leadership to support staff, and present influentially to achieve buy-in from executives, managers, and team members.
* Sound analytical skills with the ability to use and analyze data to drive informed decisions, problem-solve difficult issues, and leverage data and learnings to drive continuous improvement.
* Proven success partnering across teams, creating effective partnerships at all levels, and collaborating at an operational level.
* Adapts to change and different ways of doing things quickly and positively and finds ways to get things accomplished, even when faced with challenges.
* Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook) and preferably, Oracle.

**Preferred**

* Master’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Six Sigma Certification(s).
* Certified Lean Six Sigma (CLSS).
* Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE).

S&C Electric is committed to equal-opportunity employment. All employees and applicants will be considered without regard to age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation to complete the application, please email us at TAsupport@sandc.com.
  
  
No fixed deadline
  
  
**About Us**
In 1909, S&C Electric Company transformed the delivery of safe, reliable electricity with the invention of the Liquid Power Fuse. Today, as the world faces extreme weather events and the demand for electricity grows, S&C continues to innovate and advance the electrical grid, ensuring reliable and resilient power for homes, communities, and critical infrastructure around the world.
  
  
With a diverse, global workforce and core values around integrity, safety, and quality, S&C is a trusted industry leader and top workplace that offers meaningful careers to more than 3,500 team members. As a people-first organization, S&C is committed to fostering an inclusive and collaborative workplace where team members advance their careers through robust talent-development programs and involved leadership.
  
  
S&C’s deeply rooted belief diversity fosters greater creativity, innovation, and success guides the company to advance and sustain a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace culture.

Retirement Benefits: 401(k) Retirement Savings and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (KSOP) offering traditional and Roth 401(k) options and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) component; KSOP participants can receive annual ESOP company contributions of over 11% of eligible earnings (3% Core, up to 3.5% Match, Variable Periodic).

records.description:
Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse's mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Manager, LEU+ Manufacturing Process Engineering, you will lead process engineering. This role is part of the LEU+ Manufacturing Program, a capital expansion of Westinghouse's Columbia Fuel Fabrication Facility. The program aims to manufacture LEU+ (higher-enrichment low-enriched uranium) nuclear fuel.
